title: NewPage - Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER**
**Location :**
Chennai
  
  
**Type :**
Fulltime.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives.
  
  
We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years.
  
  
We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview.
  
  
As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end.
  
  
You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team.
  
  
You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Problem / Opportunity Discovery :
* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck.
* Reframe problems out loud.
* Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.
* Build (fast) with AI :
* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help : vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.
* Test, Deploy, Productionize :
* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline : hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks.
* Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production : TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models.
* You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture.
* You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A people-first culture : Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential.

title: Advanced SW Engineer-Data Engineering -MLOPs
description:
At Aptiv, we shape the future of mobility by developing technologies that make vehicles safer, greener, and more connected. We are building a new Data Engineering team in Chennai to develop the scalable data platforms that support our Advanced Driver Assistance Systems and autonomous driving solutions.
  
  
As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate production-grade data pipelines and cloud-native services for large volumes of vehicle, sensor, validation, and engineering data. You will work with global engineering, product, AI/ML, and automotive-domain teams to make trusted data discoverable, reliable, secure, and ready for analytics and machine learning. Depending on your experience, you may own technical workstreams, define engineering standards, and mentor other engineers as the India team grows.
  
  
**Your Roles and Responsibilities:**
**Core Competencies & Demonstrated Success:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines that ingest data from vehicles, sensors, APIs, files, databases, and cloud services.
* Build reusable ETL/ELT frameworks for transforming raw data into curated, analytics-ready and ML-ready datasets.
* Design data models and storage patterns across data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, and SQL and NoSQL systems.
* Develop APIs and data services that enable secure, efficient access to raw and processed data.
* Implement automated data validation, reconciliation, schema checks, lineage, metadata, and quality monitoring across the data lifecycle.
* Improve pipeline reliability through observability, alerting, retry and recovery patterns, testing, and systematic root-cause analysis.
* Optimise distributed processing, storage, and query performance while balancing scalability, availability, and cloud cost.
* Apply security, privacy, access-control, retention, and governance requirements to data products and platforms.
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, containerised workloads, and deployment practices for data services across AWS and/or Azure.
* Partner with AI/ML and MLOps teams to deliver high-quality datasets, features, and interfaces for model development, validation, and production workflows.
* Collaborate with global product, platform, embedded, validation, security, and domain teams to translate requirements into maintainable data solutions.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, coding standards, technical documentation, peer reviews, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–10 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python and advanced working knowledge of SQL.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale datasets; experience at petabyte scale is preferred.
* Experience with data modelling, relational databases, NoSQL systems, and cloud object storage.
* Experience with distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark or an equivalent managed platform.
* Practical experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS or Azure) and its data, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
* Experience with workflow orchestration and scheduling tools such as Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Step Functions, or equivalent.
* Proficiency with Git, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD practices.
* Good understanding of data quality, schema evolution, idempotency, partitioning, performance tuning, observability, and failure recovery.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex data and platform issues using a structured, evidence-driven approach.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across functions and geographies.

**Bonus / Preferable to have**

* Experience with streaming and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or Event Hubs.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Exposure to data lakehouse, transformation, or table-format technologies such as Databricks, dbt, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or equivalent.
* Experience with monitoring and visualisation tools such as Grafana, Kibana, OpenSearch/ELK, Qlik Sense, or Power BI.
* Familiarity with MLOps platforms, feature or dataset management, and data workflows for model training and validation.
* Experience with ADAS, autonomous driving, automotive, IoT, telemetry, sensor, image, video, or other high-volume engineering datasets.
* Working knowledge of Java, Scala, C, or C++ where integration with platform or embedded systems is required.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading the technical delivery of a workstream.

Why join us?
  
  
**You grow at Aptiv.**
Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.
  
  
**You make an impact at Aptiv.**
One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.
  
  
**You have support at Aptiv.**
We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.
  
  
**Your Benefits at Aptiv:**

* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);
* Life and accident insurance;
* Sodexo cards for food and beverages
* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;
* EAP Employee Assistance;
* Access to fitness clubs (T&C apply);
* Creche facility for working parents;

**Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv:**
**At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most.**
Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on—advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.
  
  
Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

Apply today, and together let’s change tomorrow!

title: MS-FDL-Senior Manager - Solution Architecture
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Solution Architecture**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. The ideal candidate will connect business processes, applications, data, integration, and cloud technologies to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own solution architecture quality across engagements, lead a team of architects, and partner with enterprise architecture, product, engineering, security, and business leaders to guide solutions from discovery through implementation and business value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
* Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
* Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

**Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
* Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
* Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
* Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, product owners, and clients to clarify needs and translate them into feasible solution options.
* Present solution alternatives, investment needs, trade-offs, and risks to decision-makers; secure alignment on scope, target architecture, and expected business outcomes.
* Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
* Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
* Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
* Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.
* Expertise in secure solution design, identity and access management, data protection, and enterprise governance, with working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational support.

**Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide enterprise solutions from discovery and option assessment through design governance, implementation oversight, and transition to operations.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations, and risk assessments while managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, total cost of ownership analysis, modernization planning, and evaluating performance, resilience, and scalability trade-offs.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise business processes and data models; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience in finance transformation, ERP integration, analytics platforms, or data-led enterprise transformation is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and client-facing solution presentations.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, challenge assumptions constructively, and make clear decisions under ambiguity.
* High ownership mindset focused on solution quality, implementation feasibility, sustainable technology choices, and measurable business outcomes.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Archt III-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Global Strategic Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead and solution owner for massive, high-stakes global enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle for mega-bids, orchestrating resources across all domains to ensure a cohesive, winning solution.
* Complex Network & Underlay Architecture: Design highly resilient multi-regional topologies. Architect optimal underlay mixes of global MPLS, diverse Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), and aggregated Broadband, mapping them seamlessly to intelligent SD-WAN/SASE overlays and multi-cloud interconnects.
* Advanced Voice Architecture: Architect global SIP trunking environments, geo-redundant SBC clusters, legacy PBX integrations, and intricate QoS frameworks across complex topologies.
* Private 5G (P5G) & Edge Design: Independently architect end-to-end Private 5G networks (evaluating macro/small cells and spectrum utilization) and seamlessly integrate them with local edge computing (MEC) and broader enterprise environments. Map custom network slicing policies for distinct enterprise IoT use cases.
* Advanced Automation & AI Strategy: Architect overarching frameworks for zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, and closed-loop automation. Leverage knowledge of LLM APIs to propose innovative, automated workflows for massive customer deployments.
* Practice Leadership: Serve as a technical mentor and escalation point for junior team members. Elevate the team's acumen by conducting peer reviews of complex network designs and sharing architectural best practices.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 8 to 12+ years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 5+ years in a senior customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or IC architecture role.
* Expert Networking (Underlay & Overlay): Understanding of complex routing (BGP, OSPF), legacy IP-VPN/MPLS networks, diverse internet transit (DIA/Broadband), and global SD-WAN/SASE frameworks.
* Expert VoIP & Unified Communications: Deep hands-on expertise with SIP, SBC configurations, legacy TDM/PRI transitions, and complex QoS media path optimization.
* Advanced 5G/Wireless Architecture: Extensive capability in designing Private 5G network slices, RAN/Core integrations, and Edge computing (MEC) ecosystems.
* Strategic Automation Acumen: Expert understanding of APIs, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible), and complex automated workflow deployments.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Extensive experience designing networks that connect securely to and across public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Even better if you have one or more of the following:
  
  

* Expert-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, MEF SD-WAN Subject Matter Expert (SME), or equivalent.
* Enterprise Architecture methodologies (e.g., TOGAF, ITIL) to support holistic IT transformation discussions.
* Proven track record of managing multi-vendor solutions and strategic technical alliances with top-tier OEMs during global mega-bids.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity

title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Sr. Assoc, Engineering Lead, WRB Tech
description:
**Job Summary**
Experienced Technology Delivery professional who manages the successful technical delivery of products. A skilled technology expert who works across multiple squads or hives for delivery of complex Features, Epics & Releases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver solution intent and application designs, produce clear and comprehensive design and solution intent documents.
* Support business in appropriate sequencing of the backlog, refinement, and rationalization through a technical lens.
* Oversee the implementation of microservices architecture where applicable
* Design APIs and ensure they are secure, scalable, and well-documented according to standards
* Manage and mitigate technical risks in the delivery.
* Present Solutions to the architecture review forum.
* Architecture Review Forum: 4 statements that requires PO's attestation (part of LuW):
* In submitting this initiative for approval at the QPR, I attest that I have started or completed these requirements
* Where I have started but not completed these requirements, this is in accordance with the requirements from the risk group
* Where I have not started, I have received dispensation from the respective risk group(s) to proceed without fulfilling the requirements, in part or in full
* Where I have not received dispensation, I have received approval from the QPR Coordinator to submit this initiative into the proposed backlog for approval"
* Align with technology architects on the target solution design to minimize technical debt.
* Align technical solutions and the applications with established security control requirements, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation to avoid potential penalties
* Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement the necessary security controls tailored to the specific delivery or process. Identify Applicable Security controls by engaging with Security Champs
* Review and approve the chapter 1 & 2 of the Solution Intent within the eSDLC framework before it proceeds to Domain or Country Architect approval.
* Technology Governance:
* Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production
* The controls cover: Requirements, Architecture (see Architecture Review Forum below), Security (see Cyber Security Services below), Development, Testing, IT Resilience, Service Level Management, Tech Operations & Support, Release Management, SW Configuration Management
* Complete comprehensive security impact assessments to ensure compliance with governance requirements and mitigate potential risks.
* Ensure compliance with bank compliance guidelines & standards (e.g., data protection), address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Perform solution sizing, design detailed technological solutions for platforms, applications, or collections of applications
* Collaborate with IT Change and Release Managers to develop strategic delivery and release plans with technical dependencies.
* Proactively identify cross-hive or squad dependencies and risks, and develop mitigation plans to address them without waiting for formal planning sessions.
* Develop change implementation, release plans, and run books with technical dependencies, aligning all partners with support from the squad and architect.
* Regularly reviews squad metrics on Predictability, Quality, Squad Sentiment and supports the team to better value delivery.
* Work with chapters to promote quality engineering, technical craftsmanship and drive solution standardization and service reusability.
* Develop and drive application strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Subdomain Tech Lead.
* Ensure the technical consistency of solutions in the Hive with the business architecture, technology architecture and enterprise technology standards.
* Execute the Hive’s product vision with the Chief Product Owner.
* Communicate technical feasibility and constraints, articulate clear explanation of technical issues to stakeholders
* Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives
* Influence prioritization for technology backlog and strategic initiatives.
* Incorporate considerations of technical debt into the roadmap alongside customer outcomes, ensuring a balanced approach to long-term sustainability.
* Align detailed technical solutions with strategic roadmaps, long-term architecture and product/platform vision and with overall organization's technology direction and standards
* Support the squad in clearly slice the back log into independently shippable experience for customers and responsible for technical delivery and technical excellence across the squads.
* Identify and address technical and design dependencies to enhance the speed and quality of delivery, ensuring smooth delivery.
* Accountable to work with technical counterparts to mitigate technical debt and balance risk, and regulatory items with new features, functionality, or changes to keep the cost of change low.
* Responsible to work in partnership with technology to ensure a balance of functional and non-functional requirements are represented in the backlog and that there is an approach to mitigate or avoid technical debt.
* Lead the squad in defining both functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring critical aspects like API response times and overall system performance are met.
* Act as an expert for resolving technical and design issues.
* Drive an accountable and sensible technical direction to build reusable, scalable and interoperable solutions that integrate with existing investments.
* Collaborate with vendors to integrate vendor deliverables with internal systems and resolve any issues impacting delivery.
* Drive POC or RFP and vendor evaluation exercise along with PO to ensure SCB technical standards are evaluated.
* Create and manage the E2E Implementation architecture with very strong knowledge in Internet Banking and Mobile Banking solutions architecture, customization, configuration, integration, coding, design patterns and custom business logic
* Engagement during requirements gathering
* Design review of Internet Banking and Mobile Banking solutions including integrations
* Guidance of best practices for Internet Banking and Mobile Banking implementations
* Identify potential project risks and issues
* Support anchoring of overall technical solution while cascading the same to project delivery teams
* Creating the optimum technical solution in the context of the customer's environment, requirements, and financial resources.
* Ensure adherence to Bank’s standards and acceptance at architectural review meeting.
* Development of Data Flows/Data Sets/Strategies required to support the Reporting Requirements
* Understanding the NBA requirements and the complete Internet Banking and Mobile Banking solutions architecture
* Reviewing and contributing to the deployment activities and practices
* Contributing to overall technical solution and putting it to practice

**Business**

* Develop and drive application strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the Subdomain Tech Lead.

**Processes**

* Regularly reviews squad metrics regarding Predictability, Quality, Squad Sentiment and supports the team to better value delivery.
* Work with chapters to promote quality engineering, technical craftsmanship and drive solution standardization and service reusability.

**People & Talent**

* Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives

**Governance**
**Technology Governance**

* Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production
* The controls cover: Requirements, Architecture (see Architecture Review Forum below), Security (see Cyber Security Services below), Development, Testing, IT Resilience, Service Level Management, Tech Operations & Support, Release Management, SW Configuration Management

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters

**Skills And Experience**

* Java/J2EE, Soap, Rest, XML, JSON Jspring, Jboss Fuse
* Agile/Scrum
* Cloud Engineering / Architecture
* Oracle / PostgreSQL
* Mobile Platform Skills
* DevOps
* Deep understanding and knowledge on Internet Banking and Mobile Banking
* Deep understanding and knowledge on integration layer (APIs, middleware, event streaming, data pipelines)

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in software development domain.
* Experience in the software development using Agile methodologies
* Strong Knowledge & Experience Internet Banking and Mobile Banking solution designing and implementations
* Strong architectural and integration experience
* Experience in large-scale, multi-squad delivery environments
* Knowledge & Experience in practising Agile & Lean framework
* Knowledge & Experience in the API & Microservices
* Knowledge & Experience in J2EE and good understanding of OOA and OOP
* Knowledge & Experience in Integration technologies – MQ, Kafka, Solace
* Knowledge & Experience in Container platform and Cloud technologies
* Knowledge & Experience in DevOps & SRE
* Experiences with relational databases and NOSQL databases
* Proven experience in solution management, business development, or a related field
* Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and experience with agile methodologies
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and partners
* Strong project management skills and experience leading cross-functional teams
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Strong understanding of technology and the ability to learn new technologies quickly
* Graduation or Post-Graduation in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent
* No Specific Certification is required, but a wide range of cloud, architecture certifications and trainings are expected

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Software Technical Lead
description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems.
  
  
We are currently seeking a
**Lead full Stack Developer**
, to join our Chennai Team, and this position will be directly reporting to Head of the Department.
  
  
**About us:**
Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality.
  
  
Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last.
  
  
**About the mission we offer you:**
As a Lead Full Stack Developer, the candidate will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of a scalable and high-performance application. They will work in collaboration with a team of full-stack developers in a Scrum-based environment, under the guidance of a Business Application Owner.
  
  
The Lead Developer will play a critical role in ensuring the technical quality of the application by promoting best practices, ensuring secure coding standards, and optimizing performance. The candidate is expected to mentor team members, provide technical leadership, and act as the primary point of contact for technical challenges. A deep understanding of the business domain and the ability to translate complex functional requirements into scalable technical solutions are essential for success in this role.
  
  
This role also requires hands-on technical expertise to address challenges in system design, database architecture, integration with microservices, and cloud deployment. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality software solutions that align with business needs.
  
  
**Qualifications / Skills:**

* Software Development: 8 to 12 years of experience in web software development with demonstrated leadership capabilities.
* Database Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server, database optimization, and writing complex queries.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently.

***Starting Date: Immediately***
**About you:**
We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements:
  
  
**Assignment, Context, Job Main Challenges & Key Expectations:**

* Learning Curve: The candidate is expected to quickly acquire deep knowledge of the application’s technical and business context.
* Team Leadership: The candidate will mentor and guide the development team, ensuring they follow best practices in coding, design, and testing.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Close collaboration with Product Owners (POs), test leads, and business stakeholders to refine user stories, resolve ambiguities, and ensure technical feasibility.
* Technical Ownership: The candidate will own the design, development, and delivery of complex modules, ensuring the application is secure, maintainable, and scalable.
* Code Quality and Security: The candidate is expected to champion DevSecOps practices, embedding security throughout the CI/CD pipeline and software development lifecycle. This
* includes advocating secure coding practices and leveraging tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to improve code quality and detect vulnerabilities.

+ Continuous Improvement: Staying updated with emerging technologies and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance the application and development processes.

**Job Scope:**

* Analyze user stories and oversee the translation of functional requirements into technical tasks.
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions.
* Optimize database schema design, queries, and application performance.
* Ensure robust documentation, comprehensive unit testing, and effective resolution of issues.
* Act as a mentor and guide to the development team, ensuring adherence to coding standards and promoting a culture of technical excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Actively participate in and lead all Agile ceremonies daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, demos, and refinements.
* Collaborate with Product Owners (POs), developers, and other stakeholders to refine user stories and provide technical insights.
* Estimate user stories, allocate tasks, and guide team members during refinement and sprint planning.
* Implement user stories with clean, maintainable, and secure code.
* Design scalable and reliable architecture while ensuring adherence to security and performance benchmarks.
* Utilize tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to identify and resolve code vulnerabilities, technical debt, and code smells.
* Conduct and oversee thorough code reviews to maintain quality and enforce secure coding practices.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including automated security scanning using SonarQube (SAST) and Snyk (dependency/container vulnerability checks), secrets management, DAST, and compliance-as-code, ensuring security is a shared responsibility across the development lifecycle.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, automate code review feedback, enforce code quality standards, and generate documentation; evaluate and responsibly adopt AI/ML capabilities within the application where they deliver measurable business value.
* Ensure responsible use of AI tools in line with company AI policy: review all AI-generated code before merge and never share confidential or client data in prompts.
* Manage Azure cloud resources, Azure API Management, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.
* Design and write comprehensive unit test cases to ensure high reliability and code coverage.
* Debug and resolve complex issues identified in QA, UAT, pre-production, and production environments.
* Provide production support, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system reliability during hyper-care and beyond.
* Mentor team members, facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, and foster team development.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and propose their adoption when relevant.
* Lead strategies for code cleanup, performance optimization, and process improvements.
* Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and own the technical roadmap for the application.
* Track and manage technical debt as a prioritized backlog item, agreed with the Product Owner.
* Lead incident management for production issues, including root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions.
* Coordinate with other application teams, vendors, and infrastructure and cyber security teams, including support for architecture and security reviews.
* Participate in technical interviews and contribute to hiring and onboarding developers.

**Success Measures (KPIs):**

* Sprint predictability: committed versus delivered story points.
* Defect leakage to UAT and production.
* Unit test code coverage meeting the agreed target.
* SonarQube quality gate pass rate on all pipelines.
* Closure of security vulnerabilities (SonarQube, Snyk) within the agreed SLA.
* Timely resolution of production incidents with completed RCA.
* Growth in team capability through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM)

**Your career with us**
Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development.
  
  
**What’s Next?**
Once receiving your system application, our recruiting team will screen and match your skills, experience, and potential team fit against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application.
  
  
We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting www.ten.com and follow us on LinkedIn , Instagram , Facebook , X and YouTube for company updates.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Advisor / Senior Solution Architect to

serve as a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert across strategic

customer engagements.

This is a hands-on role that spans both the sales and delivery lifecycle. The successful

candidate will lead technical solutioning, build critical components, resolve complex

implementation challenges, and remain accountable for the technical quality and successful

delivery of assigned customer solutions.

The role requires strong experience in low-code platforms, enterprise architecture, integrations,

hands-on application development, customer-facing solutioning, and technical delivery

ownership. The individual will also mentor the broader technical team and help strengthen

delivery capability, standards, and execution quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Development**

* Lead the end-to-end technical solution for strategic and enterprise customer engagements
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable applications and workflows
* Design and build complex low-code applications, workflows, integrations, data models, reports, and automation components
* Develop prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and reusable components
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex functional, technical, integration, performance, and security issues
* Establish development standards, reusable patterns, and implementation best practices

**Technical Delivery Accountability**

* Own the technical solution from pre-sales handover through implementation and go-live
* Ensure delivered solutions align with agreed business requirements, architecture, scope, and platform capabilities
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints early in the engagement
* Work closely with project managers and delivery leads to track progress, risks, and milestones
* Take ownership of technical escalations, working directly with internal teams and customers to resolve them
* Ensure successful handover, documentation, and knowledge transfer

**Pre-Sales Solutioning**

* Partner with sales and account management during opportunity discovery and solution qualification
* Lead technical discovery workshops covering business processes, systems, integrations, and security requirements
* Build proof-of-concepts and prototypes to validate proposed solutions
* Contribute to proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, and implementation roadmaps
* Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and delivery risks clearly to customers
* Identify potential expansion opportunities based on customer needs and platform capabilities

**Project & Engagement Support**

* Take ownership of selected customer projects or technical workstreams as needed
* Support project planning, milestone definition, risk tracking, and status reporting
* Manage a limited number of smaller projects alongside hands-on solution responsibilities

Team Growth & Mentoring

* Mentor solution architects, technical consultants, and developers through pairing and hands-on coaching
* Create reusable solution patterns, development standards, templates, and technical documentation
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and technical evaluation of team members

Required Experience

* Significant experience as a solution architect, technical architect, senior developer, or technical lead
* Strong hands-on experience building enterprise applications on low-code/no-code platforms such as Kissflow, Microsoft Power Platform, OutSystems, Mendix, Appian, ServiceNow, Salesforce Platform, or similar
* Proven experience leading technical solutioning across both pre-sales and delivery stages
* Strong application development experience — workflow design, data modeling, business rules, UI, integrations, reporting, and automation
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integrations, REST APIs, web services, identity and access management, databases, and cloud platforms
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues through testing, deployment, and production stabilization
* Experience contributing to proposals, statements of work, estimates, and implementation plans
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills — able to work with business stakeholders, IT teams, and senior customer leaders
* Experience mentoring technical team members while remaining an individual contributor

title: Director, Platform Engineering (Product Management)
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
**Intensity**
and
**Excellence**
define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

**This role is open to people who are currently in a product leadership role or someone in an engineering leadership role that is interested to make the switch into product.**

This role combines experienced product management leadership with the pivotal responsibilities of a Group Product Lead, offering an opportunity to shape the product strategy and the missions of several teams. You will oversee the product management execution working closely with the product managers for several cross-functional software engineering teams around the world. This position reports to the Head of Product for the Platform Engineering Strategic Business Unit, which is responsible for Appian Cloud offering.

An excellent candidate will come with a wide range of experience in a product leadership role in the cloud infrastructure domain at a software-as-a-service firm. The product portfolio owned by this position will cover a wide range of cloud native infrastructure and services – from the highly available, resilient, scalable, and efficient infrastructure components on which all Appian Cloud services operate to the the scalable, enterprise-grade managed services that power the backend data persistence and event streams for customer sites in Appian Cloud. You will provide product management leadership for initiatives that deliver efficient and scalable infrastructure, core compute capacity, and managed data planes as multi-tenant services to accelerate the innovations of Engineering teams throughout the department. Your portfolio will include aspects that intersect with AWS account and VPC topology, Kubernetes clusters, network mesh, and edge web layer, as well as efforts to transform existing systems and software components into cloud-native, Kubernetes-based and multi-tenant managed services while achieving incremental value for our customers from intermediate milestones.

You'll form strong relationships with counterparts within the Engineering department as well as stakeholders in other departments. You will oversee the creation of an impactful vision and ensure alignment between the product managers in your group and the roadmaps of the feature teams that rely on the services and frameworks provided by your organization. You will be accountable for the business impact of the features your group delivers. This includes owning the product strategy and feature backlog and ensuring effectiveness and adherence to standard product management processes.

This position is based at our office in Chennai, India. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. This role will be 5 days office based from 11th Floor, Tower B, Brigade World Trade Center, Chennai.

**What you'll do:**

* Oversee the initiation, planning, execution, and rollout for strategic initiatives.
* Lead the creation and ongoing maintenance of a multi-team, short-term and long-term feature backlogs strongly aligned to product and corporate vision.
* Initiate and facilitate conversations across business units and departments to reach alignment on strategy, roadmap, key investments and messaging.
* Build relationships with key business stakeholders, keeping them apprised of important features, critical scope changes, planned investments.
* Help identify and cultivate the next generation of product management leaders.
* Provide constructive feedback on feature specifications to ensure new feature delivery provides optimal impact.
* Coach product managers on balancing functional and non-functional enhancements and 
    
  system improvements.
* Continuously enhance and improve the product management processes and techniques at Appian.

**About you:**

* **Strong technical background, likely as a former software architect or developer.**
* Proven people management skills in guiding product managers to success.
* **Passion for the backend and infrastructure technologies that power cloud-based enterprise software systems, including proprietary, open-source, and industry-standard**
  **components, especially those in the Cloud Native Computing Foundation landscape.**
* Experience with cloud native technologies and Kubernetes. An especially strong candidate will have previous exposure to the infrastructure behind Software-as-a-Service 
    
  cloud product offerings.
* Understanding of networking and cross-VPC connectivity and the security and compliance requirements that apply to such systems with respect to enterprise 
    
  customers. Previous experience with zero trust connectivity implementations would be a strong asset.
* Understanding of data persistence, object storage services, event streaming platforms, multi-tenant shared services, and the security and compliance requirements that apply 
    
  to such systems with respect to enterprise customers.
* **Experience delivering cloud infrastructure features built using AWS services such as EKS, ECR, transit gateways, WAFs, and Global Accelerator (or similar offering from**
  **other cloud providers).**
* Strong interest in the scalability, performance, security, observability, and reliability of distributed systems.
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable talking high-level strategy with CxOs in the morning and feature details with developers in the afternoon.

**Tools and Resources**

* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

**Benefits**

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

description:

* Configure Kinaxis demand planning features to support forecasting promotion planning and demand sensing while ensuring alignment with business planning cycles

* Partner with client leadership to define value realization metrics and roadmaps that demonstrate how planning transformations improve service levels and reduce costs
* Drive defect triage and complex issue resolution during testing and hypercare phases to maintain solution stability and planning confidence
* Engage with platform and infrastructure teams to optimize environment setup capacity planning and backup strategies for critical planning applications
* Document solution decisions design rationales and operating procedures to support future enhancements and knowledge transfer across global teams

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive experience with Kinaxis supply planning including configuration scenario modelling and deployment in large scale environments
* Demonstrate strong expertise in Kinaxis demand planning with hands on experience in forecast models statistical parameters and consensus planning workflows
* Exhibit solid grounding in Kinaxis fundamentals including data modeling planning engine concepts and administration of user roles and planning calendars
* Apply deep domain experience in retail planning to design solutions that address assortment allocation replenishment and store level planning needs
* Utilize comprehensive knowledge of supply chain management to align technology solutions with sourcing manufacturing distribution and logistics processes
* Communicate effectively in hybrid work settings by collaborating with distributed stakeholders and teams while maintaining clear documentation and updates
* Adapt quickly to evolving client requirements and emerging Kinaxis features while upholding high standards of architecture integrity and delivery quality

Kinaxis RapidResponse Author Certification or equivalent Kinaxis certified professional credential

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. * Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.

* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.

* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**About the job**
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.
  
  
It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.
  
  
One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building Kafka Connect charter which is core for scalable and reliable streaming data between Apache Kafka® and other data systems. It makes it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets in and out of Kafka. Kafka Connect can ingest entire databases or collect metrics from all your application servers into Kafka topics, making the data available for stream processing with low latency. An export connector can deliver data from Kafka topics into secondary indexes like Elasticsearch, or into batch systems–such as Hadoop for offline analysis.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical vision, architecture, execution, and operations of core engineering teams that build Confluent's industry-leading Kafka Connectors.. As an IC leader of this product line, you will be responsible for guiding the world-class Connect team in driving innovation and outpacing competitors.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Work with a strong team of engineers to help evolve Confluent Connect. Work closely with product management, engineering leadership, and other key stakeholders across various teams in Confluent to build and drive the overall roadmap.
* Drive the long-term direction and strategy of Confluent Kafka connectors, while partnering with internal stakeholders to drive the team’s mission forward
* Drive the technical charter for Connect, and create competitive advantages for Kafka connectors by driving innovation. Drive improvements in the Kafka connectors to make them more usable and powerful for customers, and make them easier to adopt and scale.
* Mentor a team of high-performing engineers and leads, helping them to continue in growing their skill set through hands-on experience and mentorship. Provide timely and productive feedback, encourage a growth mindset, and advise team members in setting and working toward personal development goals.
* Build a culture of continuous improvement and prioritise large and high-impact initiatives that will fundamentally change Kafka connectors.
* Be a strong technical leader and representative for engineering teams in India. Nurture a culture of excellence on the team through a focus on hiring, communication, execution, and work quality. Create and manage processes that enable the team to do its best work.
* Continue a strong growth trajectory by hiring top tier engineers, and establish quality standards, design principles, and operational maturity for the team

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on software development experience with the ability to anticipate future technical needs for the product and craft plans to realize them.
* Taking ideas to production is something we look for. Ready to roll up your sleeves - code, debug, design - do whatever it takes to ship the product to production.
* Experience building and operating large-scale systems. Experience running production services in public clouds.
* Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development.
* A self starter with the ability to work effectively in teams. Proactively identifying the symptoms of technical issues and reason about their causes is needed. This will be followed by fixing the root causes.
* Timely shipping of deliverables; being able to trade-off short term technical decisions with the long term. Move fast, build in increments, and iterate. A sense of urgency, a mindset towards achieving results, and excellent prioritization skills.
* Ability to influence the team, peers and upper management in technology decisions using effective communication and collaborative techniques
* Strong mentorship track record, guiding the team in building out complex systems, and helping them in their professional development.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience. Understanding of various technologies, programming paradigms and frameworks is needed. Ability to be pragmatic and trade off their usage in production is essential.
* Ability to take on intense customer production issues on-call; debugging and mitigating them will be needed. This requires patient log and metrics analysis with solid reasoning to nail the issue.
