title: Engineering Lead
description:
**Engineering Lead**

**Company:**
Stoopa.AI

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
Typically 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership and delivery ownership

About Stoopa.AI

Stoopa.AI builds TURI, a software platform for ports, terminals, and container logistics operations. TURI connects operational data, real-time visibility, configurable workflows, and decision intelligence to help customers coordinate operations and make better decisions.

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can guide engineers, make sound architectural decisions, establish practical engineering standards, and take accountability for delivery and customer outcomes.

About the role

As Engineering Lead, you will own technical direction and engineering delivery for your team. You will turn product priorities and customer requirements into clear designs, executable plans, and dependable releases.

You will remain actively involved in design, code reviews, implementation, and production troubleshooting while helping engineers deliver effectively. You will also serve as a primary technical contact for customers across the world, leading technical discussions, managing expectations, and ensuring that commitments are understood and followed through.

Our technology includes Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, Python, SQL databases, and Redis, deployed in cloud environments. Machine learning and agentic AI experience are significant advantages.

·        Lead architecture and technical design across frontend applications, backend services, databases, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

·        Translate business goals and customer requirements into technical plans, milestones, estimates, and clear ownership.

·        Take accountability for end-to-end delivery, from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, customer acceptance, and production support.

·        Coordinate engineering work, manage dependencies, remove blockers, and address delivery risks early.

·        Work with product leadership and customers to agree priorities, clarify scope, and communicate trade-offs when requirements or timelines change.

·        Establish and improve practical standards for architecture, coding, reviews, testing, security, documentation, CI/CD, and production monitoring.

·        Guide and mentor engineers, delegate effectively, provide constructive feedback, and hold the team accountable for quality and commitments.

·        Contribute code to critical or complex areas and help resolve difficult technical and production issues.

·        Lead customer requirements workshops, technical demonstrations, integration discussions, and rollout planning across countries and time zones.

·        Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and recovery plans clearly to customers and company leadership.

·        Drive incident resolution and follow-up improvements that strengthen reliability and prevent recurring issues.

·        Evaluate technologies thoughtfully, including ML and agentic AI approaches, and guide their use where they solve a clear product or customer need.

What you bring

·        Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience leading engineers and delivering production software.

·        Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot expertise, with the ability to guide full stack development using React and TypeScript.

·        Practical Python development experience.

·        Strong SQL, relational database design, query optimization, and Redis caching experience.

·        Experience designing maintainable systems, APIs, and integrations, with attention to security, reliability, and performance.

·        Practical cloud architecture and deployment experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

·        Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and production operations.

·        A track record of owning delivery, managing scope and dependencies, and responding constructively when plans change.

·        Excellent written and oral communication skills, including clear technical proposals, delivery updates, and customer-facing discussions.

·        Experience managing direct technical relationships with customers, resolving ambiguity, and setting realistic expectations.

·        Strong ownership and accountability, including the willingness to make decisions, escalate risks, and follow through on outcomes.

·        Ability to lead through clear direction, technical credibility, coaching, and collaboration.

·        Ability to coordinate with international customers and distributed teams across time zones.

Experience that is a significant plus

·        Designing, deploying, or operating machine learning capabilities in production.

·        Building agentic AI applications using LangGraph, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

·        Microsoft Azure architecture and operations experience.

·        Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, event-driven systems, or Kubernetes.

·        Familiarity with logistics, ports, terminals, or enterprise operational systems.

Why join us

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, engineering practices, and delivery of a product serving international customers. You will work closely with company leadership, guide a hands-on engineering team, and help turn complex operational requirements into reliable software

title: Lead Engineer WAN & Edge Architect
description:
**About The Role**
The backbone of TD SYNNEX's global network is routing, switching, and increasingly SD-WAN. Across more than 100 countries, hundreds of sites, and three distinct regional engineering teams, the decisions made at the routing and switching layer - how traffic flows, how sites fail over, how edge connectivity is managed - touch everything. Today, those decisions are made regionally, without a global solutions-level owner who can set direction, resolve the hardest problems, and ensure consistency.
  
  
This role is that owner. As our Routing, Switching & SD-WAN Solutions Engineer based in India, you will serve as the global technical authority for network infrastructure design across all layers: campus and data center switching, WAN and carrier connectivity, and SD-WAN edge architecture. You will design solutions for the most complex network challenges in the environment, set global standards, and act as the senior escalation point for routing and switching issues that regional teams cannot resolve on their own.
  
  
This is a design and architecture role. You should be equally comfortable drawing a network topology, writing a technical standard, debugging a BGP route leak, and presenting a recommendation to leadership. We are not looking for someone who runs tickets - we are looking for someone who eliminates the class of problem that generates them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and architect routing and switching solutions for TD SYNNEX's global network - campus LAN, WAN, data center interconnect, and SD-WAN edge
* Serve as the global escalation point for complex routing, switching, and SD-WAN issues - own the problem, lead the resolution, document the fix as a standard
* Define and maintain global network design standards: topology templates, routing policy, QoS frameworks, VLAN strategy, and SD-WAN deployment models
* Evaluate and recommend SD-WAN architecture direction - provider selection, edge deployment models, application-aware routing, and zero-touch provisioning approaches
* Review network designs for new site build-outs, warehouse deployments, and corporate office expansions across all regions before implementation
* Partner with the Americas Network Lead, Daniel Salamanca in Europe, and the APJ engineer to align regional implementations with global standards
* Collaborate with the India Automation & Observability engineer to define what network telemetry and alerting looks like for routing and switching infrastructure
* Lead cross-functional engagement on network requirements for new business initiatives - acquisitions, new market entries, application migrations

**Qualifications**
**You Must Have:**

* 10-15 years of enterprise network engineering experience with a strong focus on design and architecture, not just operations
* Expert-level knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and spanning tree - including how they interact and where they break at scale
* Hands-on design and deployment experience with SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela/SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, or similar)
* Deep understanding of enterprise LAN/WAN architecture: campus switching, redundancy design, QoS, and carrier circuit management
* Experience working across a multi-site, multi-country network environment and setting standards that regional teams can execute
* Strong written and spoken English; able to document architecture decisions and present recommendations clearly to both engineers and leadership
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy as a global SME with peers across multiple time zones

**Nice To Have**

* CCIE Routing & Switching or Enterprise Infrastructure (active or prior); CCNP Enterprise at minimum
* Experience with data center switching and fabric architectures (Cisco ACI, VXLAN/EVPN)
* Familiarity with carrier and ISP relationships - circuit ordering, SLA management, peering
* Exposure to network design in a global IT distribution, logistics, or e-commerce environment
* Experience with multi-vendor environments and the ability to design vendor-agnostic solutions

**What This Role Offers**

* The broadest technical scope on the global network team - routing and switching touches every site, every region, and every other solution area
* A senior seat in a newly established India Solutions Hub designed to be the technical center of gravity for TD SYNNEX's global network engineering function
* Direct collaboration with the Global Director of Network Engineering and regional leads in the Americas and Europe
* The opportunity to define global network architecture standards from the ground up - not inherit someone else's decisions
* Clear growth path: as TD SYNNEX expands and the network team matures, this role is positioned to grow into a principal or staff engineer function

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* 10 to 15 Years of relevant work experience.
* Bachelor's Degree with Network Engineering or Related field of study required.
* Other Education / Certifications: - Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Data Center, CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCIE Enterprise Wireless, CCIE Collaboration, Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE), F5 (or other load balancer) Certified Solution Expert, SNIA Storage Networking Certificate.
* Able to execute instructions and to request clarification when needed.
* Able to perform basic mathematical calculations.
* Able to recognize and attend to important details with accuracy and efficiency.
* Able to communicate clearly and convey necessary information.
* Able to create and conduct formal presentations.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About The Team**
CloudBees builds CloudBees Unify, a governed software delivery platform spanning CI/CD, release orchestration, and feature management. Feature Management is the capability that lets teams ship code with a feature turned off, roll it out gradually, and kill it instantly if something breaks, no redeploy needed.
  
  
This team is moving into a new org, and that's where you come in.
  
  
You'd inherit a team spread across three continents and about ten time zones, and likely pick up one or two additional small teams alongside it. The team includes engineers who do not need you to tell them how to write code. What they need is someone who clears the path between them and shipping and treats "I don't know, let me find out" as a perfectly good answer in a 1:1.
  
  
This is the role today. If you do it well, there's room to take on more.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own delivery and team health for Feature Management
* Steer decisions with questions, then let your engineers own the architecture. If you're the one drawing the boxes, something's gone wrong
* Give feedback in the moment, not in a surprise essay once a year
* Hire, grow, and have the hard conversations when someone isn't where they need to be
* Cut process that exists because someone was once scared
* Use AI agents to run your own job faster: pull together who's on PTO next week, the lead time of your team's PRs, what ticket needs attention, what shipped and what it broke, instead of digging through five tools by hand

Not write code. Not approve every PR. Not sit in on every incident call because you don't trust the on-call rotation.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Must have**

* A track record of improving automation and developer tooling, not just using what's handed to you
* At least 5 years as a software developer before moving into management, so the technical instincts below are earned, not borrowed (ideally, you have developed in Go)
* 5+ years as an actual engineering manager, with 5 or more direct reports at once. Not a tech lead with 3 reports and half a week of coding
* Genuinely technical: enough hands-on background in CI/CD, feature flagging, or platform engineering to ask a sharp question in a design review, plus real experience managing engineers who are better coders than you, and you're comfortable with that
* A track record of running distributed, multi-timezone teams: clear owners, clear deadlines, decisions that don't wait on a meeting that nine time zones won't allow
* You take the heat for your team and hand them the credit
* The instinct to measure what shipped and what it did for customers, not green dots in Slack. You know deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore, and you use them to start conversations, not to rank people
* A real appetite for AI: recent, hands-on use of at least one coding agent (Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, Kiro, or similar) to run your own work, not necessarily to ship product code. You push your team to try these tools too, and have opinions about where they help and where they don't, not secondhand takes from a keynote you watched once
* Experience taking over a team mid-transition

**Nice to have**

* A sense of humor. You'll need one some days, and it'll help on the good ones too
* Prior exposure to release orchestration
* Java development experience

**Who This Is For**
You'd rather ask what's actually blocking someone than "why isn't this done yet." And when the unpopular call is needed, you make it, even when the timing is inconvenient.
  
  
You're fine with ambiguity that has a shape, not ambiguity that's just chaos with a Jira board. Sharp and a little irreverent beats technically flawless but rigid, as long as you still ship.

**Job Description**
**Role Requirement**

* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network hardware, and enterprise security architecture.

* Good understanding of core networking concepts (VLANs, layer 2/3 routing, access lists, load balancing) and hands-on experience administering enterprise firewalls (rule management, VPN, NAT, segmentation).
* Ability to think through problems and design solutions across hybrid, cross-platform environments (Windows and macOS); ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot end-to-end.
* Automate manual processes using AI tools wherever possible, to improve troubleshooting, documentation, and day-to-day infrastructure operations.

**Job Requirements**
**Identity & Hybrid Directory Services**

* Designing, planning, migrating, and implementing Active Directory in environments with 2,500+ users.
* Designing, implementing, and troubleshooting Directory Synchronization and Federation Services (Azure AD Connect / Cloud Sync, ADFS) for Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).

* DNS/DHCP and Group Policy design.
* Hands-on experience managing DNS records (A, CNAME, MX, TXT, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC) across internal and external DNS zones.
* Designing on-premises AD with Hybrid Azure AD Sync.
* Active Directory hands-on experience in multi-site / multi-domain / multi-forest environments.
* Deep knowledge of Active Directory and Entra ID, including Group Policy, Federation, and Single Sign-On.
* Strong experience with AD enterprise certificate services, rights management server, AD Federation Services, and identity manager.
* Experience with Active Directory consolidation/migration (Quest migration experience and ADMT a plus) and running AD health checks.
* Strong experience with IP Address Management (IPAM) solutions.

**Cloud & Endpoint Security (Microsoft Defender Suite)**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (CASB) policy creation, OAuth app governance, shadow IT / cloud app discovery.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, device onboarding, EDR, attack surface reduction, vulnerability management.
* Working knowledge of Defender for Identity and/or Microsoft Sentinel is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with email security solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Office 365 or similar anti-phishing, anti-spam, safe links/attachments, and mail flow security.
* O365 security and compliance administration.

**Endpoint Management- Windows & Mac**

* Hands-on experience with O365, Intune, and MDM for Windows endpoints.
* Hands-on experience managing macOS/Apple devices using Kandji, Jamf, or a similar Apple MDM, including Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.
* Hands-on experience handling servers such as Windows Server 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2022.
* Cross-platform patching, security, performance, and backup/recovery best practices across Windows and macOS.

**Network & Firewall**

* Strong experience with core networking (VLANs, layer 2/3 routing, ACLs, load balancing).
* Hands-on administration of enterprise firewalls, including rule management, site-to-site and remote-access VPN, NAT, and network segmentation.
* Working knowledge of SD-WAN technologies and ISP/circuit concepts (MPLS, broadband, leased lines, last-mile connectivity, failover and redundancy).
* Working knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions such as FortiClient EMS or Zscaler, or similar.

* Own end-to-end technical direction and standards across identity, cloud, endpoint, and network/security domains — not execution within a single domain only.

You are a Genesys Cloud expert with solid understanding of CCaaS, Omnichannel architecture, Digital Channels, Workforce Management (WFM), queuing and routing, conversational design using Genesys Cloud Architect, AppFoundry solutions, and AI‑driven automation including Dialog Engine, bots and NLP.
  
  
In this role, you are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, effectively managing complex priorities, meeting deadlines, and performing well under demanding circumstances. Your work regularly involves global coordination, and you collaborate with teams across regions and time zones; therefore, strong communication and interpersonal skills are critical for influencing stakeholders, aligning diverse technical teams, and driving architectural decisions in a multinational environment.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Join athenahealth as a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a newly formed engineering team advancing our Integration Platform. You will build and develop the team, guide technical direction, and own the delivery of scalable, reliable integration solutions.
  
  
Working closely with engineering, product, architecture, and operational stakeholders, you will help simplify healthcare data exchange and improve the experience of developers, customers, and integration partners. A key focus will be advancing automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve engineering productivity.
  
  
**Team Summary**
The Integration Platform is part of the athenahealth Data and Ecosystem Platform subdivision. It supports internal data exchanges and connections between athenahealth and laboratories, imaging providers, registries, health information exchanges (HIEs), payers, other electronic health record (EHR) systems, faxing services, and third-party vendors serving healthcare practices.
  
  
A core component is our proprietary HL7 engine, which supports more than 15,000 contexts, approximately 20,000 connections, and millions of subscriptions. These connections use protocols and connectivity methods such as SFTP, HTTPS, APIs, and VPN sockets, making scalability, performance, and reliability central to the team’s work.
  
  
The platform supports inbound and outbound HL7 connections, alongside custom integrations for specific customer needs. Self-service tools and a dedicated advisory team support the onboarding, development, and validation of new integrations.
  
  
The Chennai team will expand these capabilities through platform improvements, process automation, and AI-powered tools that simplify integration development, testing, and onboarding.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices across planning, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance, with appropriate engineering review and quality controls.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, self-service, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve developer and customer experiences.
* Establish and track meaningful measures of delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and integration turnaround time.
* Lead the evolution of existing systems while supporting new functionality and maintaining operational continuity.
* Foster agile / AIDLC development practices and use delivery outcomes and team feedback to improve how the team works.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Coach and mentor engineers through regular feedback, career development, and opportunities to strengthen technical and leadership skills.
* Own engineering planning and delivery for integration and faxing solutions, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Partner with product, architecture, and engineering leaders to translate business objectives into a technical roadmap and achievable delivery plans.
* Guide architectural decisions and engineering practices that improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the long-term architecture and modernization strategy for the Integration Platform.
* Lead recruiting, onboarding, and talent development to build the capabilities needed for the team’s roadmap.
* Partner with operational and advisory teams to identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Maintain productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and vendors.
* Support production readiness, incident resolution, and follow-up improvements that strengthen platform reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI development tools through focused experiments with measurable outcomes.
* Share technical knowledge and effective engineering practices across teams.

**Expected Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* At least 12 years of experience across software development and engineering leadership, including experience managing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop teams, manage performance, and deliver complex software initiatives.
* Strong technical background in Java and experience designing, developing, or operating scalable enterprise software.
* Experience guiding architectural decisions, managing technical trade-offs, and improving software quality and operational reliability.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and opportunities to apply AI and automation to engineering workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical audiences

***Our vision:***

We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

—

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Full-time

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**AI Engineering Manager / Lead**
to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform.

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions. The role will involve building AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and enterprise integrations while driving engineering excellence, innovation, and delivery outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Engineering & Solution Development**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI applications leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Architect and implement multi-agent systems, intelligent workflows, tool calling, and autonomous task execution with appropriate human oversight.
* Build scalable RAG pipelines integrating enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, vector databases, and semantic search capabilities.
* Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, APIs, and services to accelerate product engineering and solution delivery.
* Drive end-to-end AI application development, from proof of concept and experimentation to production deployment and continuous improvement.

**2. AI Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Define and implement scalable AI application architectures aligned with enterprise requirements for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Evaluate and integrate LLMs, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and other AI technologies based on business and technical requirements.
* Design robust prompt engineering, context management, agent orchestration, memory, and model interaction strategies.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for AI application development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Drive architectural decisions related to model selection, latency, token consumption, inference costs, and scalability.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Platform Engineering**

* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge systems, and existing technology ecosystems.
* Build secure, reusable microservices and APIs to support enterprise AI workflows.
* Collaborate with platform, cloud, DevOps, and security teams to establish reliable deployment and operational practices.
* Enable interoperability across AI models, tools, enterprise systems, and data sources.
* Contribute to reusable platform capabilities supporting Purple Fabric’s enterprise AI and decisioning use cases.

**4. AI Quality, Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish evaluation frameworks to assess AI output quality, factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, and reliability.
* Implement guardrails to address hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, data leakage, and unauthorised tool execution.
* Drive observability and monitoring for AI applications, including tracing, latency, token usage, cost, and failure analysis.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, access control, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
* Implement continuous evaluation and regression testing to maintain AI solution quality as models, prompts, and data evolve.

**5. Engineering Management & Delivery**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists.
* Own technical delivery, engineering quality, resource planning, prioritisation, and execution against agreed timelines.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving sessions.
* Establish engineering KPIs covering delivery predictability, code quality, production stability, performance, and productivity.
* Work closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, Presales, and business stakeholders to translate product requirements into engineering deliverables.
* Foster a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* **AI / GenAI:**
  Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLM-based application development, and production AI systems.
* **Agentic AI:**
  Experience designing agent-based applications, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and workflow automation.
* **RAG:**
  Strong understanding of document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimisation, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* **Programming:**
  Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade applications, services, and APIs.
* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
* **Model Ecosystem:**
  Experience working with commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama-based models.
* **Data & Integration:**
  Experience with REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, and distributed systems.
* **Cloud & Deployment:**
  Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerisation and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes.
* **AI Evaluation & Security:**
  Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt security, guardrails, and production monitoring.
* **Engineering Practices:**
  Strong knowledge of software architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, Git, code reviews, and production support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms, reusable AI frameworks, or AI products at scale.
* Exposure to financial services, banking, payments, lending, fraud detection, risk, or other regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with model gateways, model routing, inference optimisation, caching, and cost management.
* Familiarity with enterprise knowledge management, identity and access management, data governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI application observability.
* Exposure to on-premises or private-cloud AI deployments and enterprise security constraints.
* Experience taking AI products from 0-to-1 development through production rollout and scaling.

**Leadership & Competencies**

* Strong technical ownership and the ability to make sound architecture and engineering decisions.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams and deliver complex technology initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance experimentation and innovation with production reliability and delivery commitments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI concepts to engineering teams, product leaders, and business stakeholders.

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of scalable, production-ready enterprise AI capabilities.
* Improved reliability, quality, and performance of AI applications and agentic workflows.
* Reduced inference costs and latency through effective architecture and optimisation.
* Strong engineering quality, predictable delivery, and effective team development.
* Reusable AI components that accelerate product development and enterprise adoption.
* Compliance with enterprise security, governance, and responsible AI standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineering leader who has
**built and scaled production-grade GenAI or Agentic AI solutions**
, rather than someone whose experience is limited to traditional machine learning, data science, AI research, or integrating basic LLM APIs.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to architect end-to-end AI systems, lead engineering teams, solve enterprise-scale technical challenges, and translate AI capabilities into secure, reliable, business-ready products.

title: Lead Engineer Network Observability
description:
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Lead Network Engineer, Architect - Observability to own the strategy and architecture behind how we see, understand, and act on the health of our global network. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who has spent a decade or more in network engineering and now wants to define how a large, multi-region network gets monitored, correlated, and made predictable rather than reactive.
  
  
You'll be the architect of our observability capability end to end, spanning monitoring platforms, telemetry, analytics, and the roadmap that ties it all to business outcomes like uptime, mean time to resolution, and cost avoidance.
  
  
**What You'll Do
  
  
Observability Strategy and Architecture**

* Own and advance a multi-year observability maturity roadmap for the global network
* Architect unified observability solutions spanning our monitoring platforms rather than siloed point tools
* Define predictive alerting and anomaly detection capabilities to move the organization from reactive to proactive
* Build observability use cases grounded in business goals, not just technical coverage
* Set observability best practices and standards used across regions
* Evaluate emerging observability and AIOps technologies and recommend where they fit

**Analytics and Cross-Tool Integration**

* Design analytics workflows that combine data from multiple sources, such as wire data, infrastructure metrics, and flow analysis, into a coherent picture of network health
* Build predictive capacity planning models using historical performance data
* Create executive-level dashboards that correlate network health with business outcomes
* Develop anomaly detection and behavioral baseline analytics
* Design correlation logic across tools to speed up root cause analysis
* Advance visualization strategy across our reporting platforms

**Strategic Planning and Business Value**

* Lead tool portfolio rationalization and cost optimization reviews
* Build business cases and ROI models for observability investments
* Quantify the business value of monitoring capabilities in terms leadership cares about, such as uptime, MTTR, and cost avoidance
* Lead proof of concept evaluations for new observability technologies
* Assess build versus buy decisions for observability platforms and capabilities

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Serve as the senior technical voice on observability across the global network organization
* Partner with regional network teams to ensure observability standards are adopted consistently
* Work with the NOC to operationalize telemetry, health checks, and alerting so findings turn into action
* Present observability strategy, roadmap, and business impact to executive stakeholders

**What You'll Bring**

* 10-15+ years of network engineering experience, with significant time spent in observability, monitoring architecture, or network analytics
* Demonstrated experience architecting observability solutions across multiple platforms in a large, multi-site environment
* Strong background in network protocols and infrastructure (routing, switching, SD-WAN) sufficient to understand what's being monitored, not just how to monitor it
* Experience with monitoring and analytics platforms such as NetScout, DX NetOps, NetFlow, Grafana, and PowerBI, or direct equivalents
* Track record of building predictive or anomaly detection capabilities, not just dashboards
* Experience developing business cases, ROI models, and executive-level communication around infrastructure investment
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across regional teams and translate technical capability into business value
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

**Why This Role Matters**
A global network is only as manageable as it is visible. This role defines how we see problems before they become outages, how we prove the value of what we monitor, and how we turn raw telemetry into decisions leadership can act on.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**Physical/Mental Requirements**
Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.
  
  
**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**
Occasional travel up to 20%
  
  
Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.
  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.
  
  
Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.
  
  
External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.
  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED
  
  
Financial Accountability**
Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
  
  
**Supervision**
Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.
  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
  
  
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
CAT Digital is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager – DevSecOps to lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of enterprise DevSecOps capabilities across multiple product and platform portfolios. This leader will have below responsibilities:
  
  
Strategic Leadership
  
  

* Define and execute the enterprise DevSecOps and Platform Engineering strategy aligned with CAT Digital's technology vision and business objectives.
* Drive cloud modernization, automation, and platform transformation initiatives to improve agility, scalability, and operational resilience.
* Champion engineering excellence by establishing standards, governance, and best practices across software delivery and infrastructure operations.
* Leverage Generative AI and emerging technologies to improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and developer experience.
* Partner with senior business and technology leaders to influence roadmaps, investment decisions, and long-term technology strategies.
* Drive measurable improvements in reliability, deployment velocity, security posture, and cost optimization.

Organizational & People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing organization comprising DevOps, Platform Engineering and Cloud Engineering professionals.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and career growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships across engineering, product, architecture, security, and operations teams.
* Establish performance goals and coaching frameworks that enable both individual and organizational success.

Technical & Platform Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical leadership for large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, CI/CD ecosystems, container orchestration, and infrastructure automation.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions, engineering standards, and modernization strategies.
* Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps, platform engineering, and self-service capabilities.
* Establish best practices for security, observability, reliability, performance, scalability, and compliance.
* Partner with engineering leadership to ensure product teams are enabled with efficient, secure, and reliable development platforms.
* Lead initiatives focused on platform reliability, availability, incident reduction, recovery improvements, and proactive operational management.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Engineering.
* 5+ years leading engineering managers and large technical organizations.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale cloud transformation and DevSecOps initiatives.
* Demonstrated utilization of AI led efficiencies
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.

**Posting Dates**
October 27, 2026 - November 6, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

Workday is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
  
  
Further, pursuant to applicable local ordinances, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
You may view the Workday's Pay Transparency Policy, and Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law notice, by clicking on their corresponding links.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at accommodations@workday.com.
  
  
**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply

with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
13
  
  
We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as
**Director of Engineering, Data Platforms**
for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls.
  
  
This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders.
  
  
You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with
**NeoXam DataHub**
is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle—from acquisition through distribution—to create a trusted single source of truth.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform.
* Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns.
* Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support.
* Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services.
* Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms.

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement
  
  

* Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner.
* Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
* Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform.
* Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction.
* Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering.

Data Mastering Platform Integration
  
  

* Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
* Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
* Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows.
* Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data.
* Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management.

Team Leadership and Delivery Management
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering.
* Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability.
* Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members.
* Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership.
* Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms.

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards
  
  

* Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations.
* Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access.
* Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness.
* Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate.
* Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant.

**Required Qualifications**
Leadership and Delivery Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment.
* Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
* Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture.
* Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services.
* Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts.
* Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows.
* Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines.
* Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering.
* Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring.
* Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards.

Collaboration and Execution
  
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams.
* Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans.
* Comfortable operating in a role that blends technical leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery oversight.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains or asset types.
* Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging or metadata management environments, including integrations involving operational and business metadata platforms.
* Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, or golden record workflows in financial services environments.
* Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets.
* Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
* Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, and auditability requirements are important.
* Databricks certifications, AWS certifications (such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus. AWS certification paths remain relevant for modern cloud-native data engineering roles.
