title: Associate Director – Application Development
description:
This role is part of the global IT organization and will be instrumental in driving the evolution of Staples US Retail technology capabilities. The leader will oversee teams responsible for development, support, enhancements, and new initiatives across multiple product PODs spanning – Print, Transaction & Payment systems, Tech Services, Merchandising systems, QA & Automation engineering, Data team operations.

The Associate Director will lead and scale the India-based US Retail GCC engineering team (20-50+ members), ensuring seamless collaboration with US-based engineering managers, architects, quality assurance and business stakeholders. This role requires a strong leader with excellent people leadership skills, technical expertise, delivery management, and strategic & future thinking focus.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

• Lead and scale the India-based team (50+ members) within the GCC.

• Align technology strategy with Retail Systems, Business & IT objectives.

• Drive modernization of legacy systems and adoption of scalable, cloud-native platforms.

• Contribute towards budget and financial decisions related to cloud, vendor and resource costs.

• Use AI and data strategically for accurate decisions around project ROI.

• Accelerate organizational growth by driving innovation, advancing new development capabilities, and embedding continuous improvement programs

**Functional Oversight**

• Oversee systems supporting:

–
**Print & Copy Systems -**
In-store and self-service print workflow platforms. Order capture, pricing, job orchestration, and fulfillment integration. High-availability store execution and queue management

–
**Transaction & Payment Systems -**
Point-of-Sale (POS) transaction integration & publishing services. PCI-compliant payment flows across card, gift card, and alternative tenders. Integration with enterprise payment gateways

–
**Retail Technology Services -**
Technology services selling platforms (device setup, protection plans, warranties). Integration with vendor systems and service delivery partners.

–
**Merchandising & Pricing Systems –**
Pricing and promotion feeds across stores. Signage, Labor, visual merchandizing, inventory planning systems.

–
**Quality Assurance & Automation Engineering.**

–
**Data analytics & reporting operations –**
Partner with data engineering teams to provide guidance on retail transactional data and reporting processes, ensuring efficient and reliable data operations.

**Delivery & Operations**

• Ensure SLA adherence for store-facing systems.

• Drive incident reduction, faster recovery, and production resilience.

• Establish KPIs focused on transaction success rates, system availability, and operational efficiency.

**Architecture & Systems Thinking**

• Lead modernization of legacy retail platforms to cloud-native, API-driven architectures.

• Partner with architects to evolve POS-adjacent systems without store disruption.

• Champion event-driven designs supporting near real-time retail execution.

• Be a domain expert and connect the dots between various retail/ OMNI systems and corresponding data.

**Modernization & Innovation**

• Lead transformation initiatives to modernize systems and infrastructure.

• Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to enhance platform agility and resilience.

• Drive adoption of DevOps, CI/CD, and automated QA practices.

• Leverage event-driven, microservices-based architectures to build scalable and resilient systems.

**AI-Native Engineering & Force Multiplication**

• Champion an AI-native mindset across the GCC engineering organization — leveraging tools like GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted code generation, and intelligent testing to accelerate delivery and elevate engineering quality.

• Drive adoption of AI-driven SDLC practices across the team: AI-assisted design reviews, automated code analysis, intelligent documentation, and predictive quality assurance.

• Embed AI tooling into everyday engineering workflows — not just coding, but requirements analysis, architecture exploration, incident resolution, and operational intelligence.

• Act as a force multiplier by enabling engineers at all levels to leverage AI tools to amplify their impact, reduce toil, and focus on higher-order problem solving.

• Establish best practices and governance for responsible AI tool usage across the engineering organization.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

• Partner with US engineering managers, product owners and architects to align roadmaps, priorities, and delivery cadence.

• Partner with US-based vendors of platforms and IT services-based support teams globally

• Serve as a trusted advisor on strategy and execution

Requirements
  
  

**Basic Qualifications**

• Experience in
**large-scale retail environments**
supporting high-volume store operations and omnichannel systems.

• Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, React/Angular, microservices architectures, and SaaS platforms.

• Strong background in cloud platforms (Azure/GCP), system modernization, and automation

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with ability to engage directly with business teams.

title: Application Support Engineering Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Application Support (EAS) team is responsible for providing technical application support for ITP and ECS lines of business. Within EAS, the Associate Director Application Support Engineering / SRE Lead (Site Reliability Engineer Lead) is a senior technical role responsible for driving the overall reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems by implementing standard methodologies, participating in incident response, automating processes, and collaborating with development teams to ensure system stability and uptime across the organization, often acting as a technical partner in promoting a strong SRE culture within the company; key responsibilities include designing monitoring systems, capacity planning, and actively identifying and mitigating potential issues before they impact users.
  
  
The SRE team works closely with development teams, infrastructure and network partners, security partners, Scrum Masters, and internal / external clients to improve observability, operational supportability, resiliency, and mean time to restore service through driving improvements to support capabilities.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Scrum Participation: Join all project collaborators planning and design sessions, sprint zero and stand-ups for all new delivery, to champion SRE requirements reflective of a strong observability and resiliency traits.
* System Reliability Architecture: Drive Design and help implement reliable, resilient, and scalable systems, considering redundancy, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery strategies. Make design recommendations that will allow the application to recover without cleanup activities or create a recovery runbook for application support team to follow for improved application recovery times.
* Monitoring and Alerting: Develop comprehensive monitoring systems to identify potential issues proactively, define actionable alerts, and establish SLIs (Service Level Indicators) and SLOs (Service Level Objectives).

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

* Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP.

* Expertise in SQL and NO-SQL databases, Message brokers and other AWS services such as Kafka/Kinesis, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora, AWS RDS PostgreSQL.

You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

title: Director – Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce
description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery. You will help build the digital capabilities that accelerate medicines to those who need them, supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition, rigorous standards alongside creativity, and continuous learning at every step.

* Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using API Gateway and Application Load Balancer (ALB); integration with Angular/React frontends.

* Experience deploying Angular/React applications using S3 + CloudFront, including CDN caching, environment configuration, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
* Experience with Docker and EKS (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
* Experience with CloudWatch, centralized logging, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding
* Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Certification (AWS):
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* AWS Certified Developer - Associate
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Spring Security, Spring Cloud, transaction management, and asynchronous communication patterns.
* Experience with SOAP services, external application programming interface integrations, and distributed service design.
* Experience with NoSQL databases.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning concepts, including natural language processing, deep learning, or computer vision.
* Experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or natural language processing libraries.

This is not an "advisory" role — we require a practitioner who balances high-level strategic governance with deep-dive technical execution. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between traditional distributed and enterprise systems and the emerging frontier of Agentic AI, transforming how the enterprise leverages autonomous agents and LLM-driven workflows.

12-15 Years

Bangalore or Chennai, India

Hands-on Enterprise Architect

* **Architectural Strategy & Blueprint Ownership**
  
  
* Own and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — current-state and target-state views across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers.
  
  
* Define and evangelize reference architectures and reusable patterns for agentic AI systems (agent orchestration, tool-calling, memory/state management, guardrails) so delivery teams don't reinvent foundational patterns per project.

* Define standards for grounding, memory, retrieval, and context management across LLM-driven workflows.

* Evaluate and select frameworks/platforms for agent orchestration (e.g., orchestration engines, model routing, guardrail layers), balancing build vs. buy.
  
  
* **Modeling & Governance**
  
  
* Chair or actively participate in the Architecture Review Chapter; define review cadence, entry/exit criteria, and a clear exception-handling process for teams that need to move fast.
  
  
* Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and maintain a lightweight, non-bureaucratic approval workflow so governance catches drift without blocking delivery.
  
  
* Define non-negotiable guardrails for AI/agentic systems — data access boundaries, PII handling, human-in-the-loop requirements, and audit logging — that any new agent workflow must pass through review.
  
  
* Maintain enterprise modeling artifacts (capability maps, data flow diagrams, integration catalogs) as the single source of truth referenced during reviews.

* Experience designing for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency at enterprise scale.

* Experience integrating legacy enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, core platforms) with modern cloud-native and AI-driven components.

* Ability to model and maintain the data-flow view that underpins the enterprise digital twin.

* Practical experience with architecture modeling notations/tools (e.g., ArchiMate, C4 model, TOGAF-aligned frameworks) and running formal EA review processes.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  
* 12 - 15 years of progressive experience in software engineering and solution architecture.
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to strategise and develop PoC and add create practices around it.
  
  
* A portfolio of successful large-scale modernization or AI-transformation projects, ideally including experience participating in an EA governance process (ARB, ADRs) from scratch or maturing an existing one.

**About This Role**
We're seeking an exceptional Data Platform Engineer to shape the strategic direction and architecture of our data infrastructure. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll co-own the overall platform architecture, set technical standards across the entire Data Engineering organization, and drive initiatives that directly impact our data strategy. You'll be a force multiplier—inspiring teams, mentoring senior engineers, and making architectural decisions that affect how the entire organization builds and operates data systems. We are in the midst of transforming our legacy infrastructure into a modern cloud-first platform, and you'll be instrumental in leading this technical evolution.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Strategic Platform Leadership
  
  

* Co-own and evolve the overall data platform architecture across all domains
* Guide the technical vision for the entire Data Engineering organization
* Drive platform initiatives that directly support the company's data strategy
* Lead the modernization of legacy systems while ensuring business continuity
* Identify and solve problems that span the entire Data Engineering org before they impact delivery
* Set the bar for excellence and serve as an inspiration across all engineering teams

Architecture & Technical Excellence
  
  

* Design and drive implementation of highly scalable platform architectures for multi-TB+ daily workloads
* Author and sign off on all RFCs and technical specifications that touch your domain(s)
* Define best practices and patterns that become standard across the organization
* Build self-service infrastructure that empowers hundreds of data consumers while maintaining reliability
* Design event-driven, real-time data architectures using Kafka and stream processing at scale
* Contribute to any codebase across the organization, setting quality standards through exemplary code

Platform Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Architect comprehensive Infrastructure as Code strategies and GitOps frameworks
* Design enterprise-grade security frameworks including encryption, zero-trust access controls, and compliance
* Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical platform services and drive observability strategy
* Lead complex incident response, conduct thorough post-mortems, and implement systemic improvements

* Collaborate across the entire Engineering organization as a thought partner
* Interact with executives and external stakeholders as a domain expert

* Identify hiring gaps and help define interview panels for critical technical roles
* Actively participate in and contribute to Data Engineering communities (conferences, Stack Overflow, vendor forums)

What You Bring
  
  
Deep Technical Expertise
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, and at least one additional programming language
* Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented design and software engineering principles
* Deep expertise with databases across paradigms: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB
* Extensive Kafka ecosystem expertise: cluster management, Debezium, schema registry, Connect frameworks, stream processing
* Advanced container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker at scale
* Expert knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and cloud-native architectures

Platform Engineering Mastery
  
  

* Proven track record architecting platforms processing multi-TB daily workloads
* Experience designing and operating systems supporting hundreds of concurrent users
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architectures, and scalability patterns
* Expert-level experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger)
* Mastery of data orchestration platforms like Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
* Demonstrated success modernizing legacy data systems while ensuring zero business disruption

Experience & Background
  
  

* 10-15+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering or related field
* Track record of leading complex, org-wide technical initiatives
* History of driving architectural decisions that scale across large organizations
* Experience in high-growth or large enterprise environments
* Deep expertise with both modern and legacy technologies (Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects)

Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and domains
* Excellence in mentoring senior engineers and accelerating their growth
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to all levels
* Comfortable operating in high ambiguity and defining problems before solving them
* Track record of building collaborative relationships across engineering and business organizations
* Recognition as a thought leader in the Data Engineering community

Bonus Points
  
  

* Deep experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Looker, etc.)
* Machine learning infrastructure and MLOps architecture expertise
* Contributions to open-source data infrastructure projects
* Published technical articles, conference talks, or thought leadership in data platforms
* Expert knowledge of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and implementation at scale

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**First 90 Days:**
Understand our architecture deeply, identify systemic opportunities and risks, and begin influencing key technical decisions. Establish yourself as a go-to expert in your domain(s).
  
  
**First Year:**
Drive at least one major architectural initiative that impacts the entire Data Engineering organization. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to leadership and a mentor to senior engineers. Author multiple RFCs that set new standards.
  
  
**Ongoing:**
Continuously shape the technical direction of the organization, mentor the next generation of technical leaders, and maintain your position as one of the most knowledgeable experts in your domain(s) both internally and in the broader Data Engineering community.

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**
AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, extensive cloud-native services)
  
  
**Data Technologies:**
Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, SQLMESH, Snowflake, dbt

Python, SQL, Java, Scala, Docker, Kubernetes

Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, ELK Stack, Jaeger

Apache Spark, Oracle, Postgres, SqlServer, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

* 20+ years of experience in enterprise technology leadership, software engineering, architecture, and large-scale technology transformation.

* Deep expertise in J2EE and enterprise application architecture, alongside cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, DevSecOps, containerization, and enterprise integration.

* Strong hands-on technical capabilities, with the ability to guide development and engineering teams on architecture, design, implementation, and complex technical challenges.
* Strong exposure to enterprise infrastructure, security, observability, and high-availability systems.
* Excellent stakeholder management and customer-facing leadership skills.
* Prior experience working with global banking customers and regulated environments preferred.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* MBA or advanced technology/business certifications preferred.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, or enterprise technology certifications will be an added advantage.

Preferred Background

Candidates from the following environments will be preferred:

* Banking product organizations
* Transaction banking platforms
* Payments and corporate banking technology firms
* BFSI-focused SaaS/product companies
* Large-scale banking transformation practices within consulting or technology organizations

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands-on” role: you will write security-centric code, conduct deep-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
  
  
Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
  
  
Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
  
  
Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  
  
Identity/Auth: Expert-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 10+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
  
  
Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
  
  
Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  
  
Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non-technical leadership.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Secure Architecture & Threat Modeling

Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
  
  
Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
  
  
Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
  
  
  

* Offensive Security & Exploitation

In-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
  
  
Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
  
  
Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high-severity fixes.
  
  
  

* Secure Coding & SDLC Integration

Secure Code Review: Review high-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
  
  
Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). **Responsibilities**

title: Technical Anchor, Software Engineering
description:
As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.
  
  

* Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
* Anchor Technical Delivery: Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

Amazon.com is looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Digital Content Platform team. The Digital Acceleration Commerce team owns services supporting the publishing, pricing and purchase of Digital content, including Kindle Books, Amazon AppStore, Amazon Music, Amazon Video, etc.
  
  
This candidate will be joining a team working on scalable web services using cloud technologies. The work will be highly visible to Amazon customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, this person will lead the architecture and development of high-scale web services and workflows. A successful candidate will have an established background in designing and developing back-end web services, strong technical skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment, high creativity, and great analytical reasoning skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer III (SDE3) on the Digital Pricing and Promotions team, you will design and build software solutions that power promotional capabilities across Amazon's Digital Acceleration (DA) businesses — including Kindle, Prime Video, and Music. You will own and evolve critical platforms that deliver promotional management, competitive pricing intelligence, and operational automation to pricing managers, business teams, and product managers across DA.
  
  
You will take meaningful ownership of key products — particularly the Promos UI platform — driving features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Your work will span full-stack development: crafting user interfaces with modern web technologies, building robust backend services in Java on AWS, and integrating with Retail promotion systems such as PLM (Promotion Lifecycle Management).
  
  
In this role, you will make architectural decisions that balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability. You will think across systems — considering performance at scale, multi-business extensibility, and integration with diverse data sources and downstream services. You will lead technical designs independently, engage actively in design reviews, and provide substantive code review feedback that raises the bar for the team.
  
  
Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with operations teams, business stakeholders, Retail promotion platform teams, and partner engineering organizations. You will develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and pain points, translating them into well-designed, reliable solutions. You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  
  
Beyond individual delivery, you will help grow the team — mentoring junior engineers, contributing to development best practices, and driving technical improvements that increase the team's overall velocity and reliability. Success in this role means consistently shipping high-quality features that advance our promotional capabilities while setting a strong example for engineering craft and customer focus.

* 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Associate Architect
description:

Associate Architect

**Department:**
Intelligent Automation

**Location:**
Chennai, India

Mid-to-Senior Level (7 to 12 years)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high-performing
**Software Engineer transitioning into Architecture (Aspirant Architect)**
. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between hands-on code execution and high-level architectural design.

You will work directly alongside Principal Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineering Managers to architect, evaluate, and scale distributed systems on modern cloud platforms. This role is built for a senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep cloud and distributed systems experience, and a passion for system design, data modeling, and technical leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Design & Technical Leadership**

* Assist in drafting architectural blueprints, tech stack evaluation documents, and Architecture Decision
* Perform trade-off analyses balancing performance, maintainability, security, scalability, and operational costs across cloud services and codebases.
* Help define and enforce coding standards, API specifications (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and design patterns across delivery teams.

**2. Hands-on Engineering & Prototyping**

* Write production-ready, highly maintainable code (primarily using
  **Python**
  or equivalent modern languages).
* Build Proofs-of-Concept (PoCs) to test emerging technologies, validate architectural hypotheses, and bench-test performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot complex, non-deterministic bugs and failure modes in distributed production environments.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Integration**

* Architect resilient, highly available cloud applications on
  **AWS**
  or
  **Azure**
  using microservices, serverless, and containerized topologies.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and deployment strategies (Canary, Blue/Green).
* Integrate full-stack observability (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) into software architecture from inception.

**4. Data Modeling & System Design**

* Design efficient relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) schemas optimized for read/write access patterns, storage efficiency, and data integrity.
* Implement event-driven and streaming architectures using message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Event Grid).

**5. SDLC Execution & Engineering Mentorship**

* Champion the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from threat modeling and capacity planning to post-launch monitoring.
* Conduct high-impact code and design reviews, mentoring mid-level and junior engineers on clean architecture, principles, and system resilience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Software Development:**
  7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python**
  or similar languages (Go, Java, C#).
* **Distributed Computing:**
  Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems. Strong understanding algorithms, caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), load balancing, and fault-tolerance patterns (Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads).
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  3+ years of building and deploying production workloads on
  **AWS**
  (e.g., EKS/ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, S3) or
  **Azure**
  (e.g., AKS, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL).
* **Data Modeling:**
  Proficiency in designing data schemas) and database migrations, and query optimization.
* **DevOps & IaC:**
  Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep), and automated pipeline tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* **Full SDLC Mastery:**
  Practical exposure to complete software life cycles, agile methodologies, secure coding practices (OWASP top 10), and automated testing frameworks (Unit, Integration, E2E).

**Behavioral & Aspirant Attributes**

* **Architecture Mindset:**
  Strong grasp of software design philosophies (Domain-Driven Design, SOLID principles, 12-Factor App methodology, Clean Architecture).
* **Communication:**
  Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and write concise technical documentation.
* **Continuous Learner:**
  Eagerness to evolve from feature implementation to enterprise-wide system strategy.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional) or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with data engineering pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or similar).

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**About Cognizant**
Cognizant is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Cloud Security Architect**
, you will lead the design, validation, and governance of security architecture across enterprise cloud and hybrid environments. You will play a critical role in ensuring cloud-native and hybrid architectures align with Cognizant’s security reference architecture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multi-cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  
  
You will work independently with senior stakeholders, enterprise architects, security teams, cloud engineering teams, DevSecOps practitioners, and compliance leaders to provide end-to-end ownership of cloud security architecture from threat modeling and design reviews through implementation validation and operational governance. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic cloud adoption initiatives, modern security architectures, and enterprise-wide cloud governance programs while mentoring teams and driving security excellence.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Govern the security architecture of enterprise cloud and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI platforms.
* Conduct cloud security architecture reviews covering Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and Zero Trust security models.
* Partner with Cloud Management Office, enterprise architecture, security, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements into cloud design and architecture decisions.
* Define and implement cloud security standards, architectural patterns, governance controls, and security guardrails.
* Embed security requirements into Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation frameworks.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and security requirements.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, container platforms, serverless technologies, and AI-enabled solutions while providing architectural guidance and security recommendations.
* Serve as the primary security architecture liaison between enterprise architecture, security governance, control validation, IT security, and business stakeholders.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for cloud architecture initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance reviews, risk assessments, threat modeling exercises, and solution validation activities.
* Mentor security, architecture, cloud, and engineering teams on secure cloud operations and cloud security best practices.
* Stay current on cloud provider roadmaps, threat landscape developments, regulatory requirements, and industry security standards.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in information security and cybersecurity architecture.
* 8+ years of experience securing enterprise cloud environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and/or OCI.
* Proven experience designing and governing cloud security architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud architecture security reviews and evaluating security controls against cloud frameworks and assurance programs.
* Experience implementing and governing cloud security requirements within DevSecOps environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture, threat modeling, risk management, and security governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, compliance, risk, audit, and operational stakeholders.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and guiding architecture, engineering, or validation teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for improving the security posture of cloud environments.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Palo Alto Cortex, API Security, DSPM, Zscaler and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Google Cloud Platform security services and governance frameworks.
* Experience with container platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes security, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh technologies.
* Strong cloud networking expertise including VNet/VPC design, hub-and-spoke architectures, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, firewall controls, and micro-segmentation.
* Expertise in Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, PIM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and SIEM/SOAR integrations.
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks including PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
* Experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, GitOps, and CI/CD security controls.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, and cloud automation practices.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Leadership experience coaching and mentoring architects, engineers, and security practitioners.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500) or equivalent AWS Certified Security – Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification.
* Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent AWS or GCP Professional Architect certification.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).

**Work Model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
