title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Manger
description:
Who are Inchcape?
  
  
At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.
  
  
We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.
  
  
Job Purpose :
  
  
As a key part of the infrastructure discipline within the IT Ops function in Inchcape, you will be responsible for managing our core technology systems as a product, aligning with our business goals and managing teams, budgets, planning, design, implementation and maintenance of the foundational IT environment.
  
  
The role involves managing the BAU infrastructure services function, delivering projects such as new services, mergers and acquisitions, cloud migrations and equipment refresh and budget management. While also maintaining/monitoring the existing applications and server environment in place.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities :
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Planning: Product management, develop long-term roadmaps, ensuring scalability, and aligning IT infrastructure with business objectives.
* System Oversight: Manages Cloud, software, licences, networks, servers, storage, databases, and security systems across our global network and SaaS services.
* Security & Compliance: Enforces security standards, manage firewalls, monitors for breaches, and ensures regulatory compliance.
* Team management: Leads and mentors IT teams, fosters collaboration, and coordinates with other departments. Team Consists of Wintel, Desktop and DevOps Engineers, performance appraisals, setting goals and objectives, ensuring 24/7 on-call and support availability.
* EUC as Product: Manage end-user compute team, define technology roadmap and strategy, engage users and focus on user experience, workforce flexibility and enhancing productivity.
* Budget & Performance: Manages IT budgets, tracks key performance indicators (KPIs), and optimizes system performance.
* Project Management: Oversees infrastructure projects, including planning, timelines, staffing, and implementation.

Key Focus Areas
  
  

* Stability & Availability: Ensures systems run optimally with high uptime.
* Data Security: Protects valuable organizational data.
* Scalability: Prepares infrastructure for future growth and increased demands.
* Business Alignment: Translates technical needs into business language, ensuring technology supports goals.

Essential skils and Experience :
  
  

* Cloud platforms: Deep knowledge of major cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, SharePoint, Windows, Linux, Hybrid, M365 (including M365 AD Sync and Entra ID inc. B2B and B2C), and AWS (Control Tower, Landing Zone, AD Sync, EC2, Backup, VPC, Transit Gateway, S3, CloudTrail and CloudWatch) DR/Business continuity testing.
* Automation and scripting: Experience with tools like Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python.
* Infrastructure fundamentals: Strong understanding and implementation of best practices on Cloud (AWS, Azure) and core infrastructure concepts like networking, servers, storage, backups.
* Security: Experience with security best practices, vulnerability management, and access control. Ensuring systems are patched monthly. MFA and Conditional Access.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical teams and manage projects. Be a point of escalation in and out of hours
* Problem-solving: Analytical and systematic approach to diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues. Lead on Problem analysis to resolution.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders and report to senior management.
* ITIL: Familiarity with IT service management frameworks like ITIL, ensuring systems meet or exceed KPI’s and SLA’s
* Monitoring: Monitoring systems including Synthetic monitoring and RUM.
* Licensing: Experience of MS licensing and the different licensing models

Qualification :
  
  

* Experience: 8+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems, or network roles.
* Qualifications: AWS Solutions Architect, CompTIA A+. MS 365 Endpoint Administrator Endpoint, CCNA.
* Hybrid environments: Experience with hybrid cloud models.
* Databases: Knowledge of database systems (e.g., MS SQL, AWS Postgres)
* Change management: Experience with formal change control processes

Other requirements :
  
  

* Ability to travel (national and international) and work flexibility
* Able to work from home
* Able to work aligned to UK Hours
* Willing to work unsociable hours and be part of the on-call rotas.

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?
  
  
We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realise the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.
  
  
Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:
  
  
Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture.
  
  
The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
  
  
Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.
  
  
In return, we will offer you:
  
  
A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive:
  
  

* A retirement savings plan
* Life assurance
* Holiday
* Competitive salary
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Career development and progression opportunities
* Values Award celebration events

Plus, much more!
  
  
If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!
  
  
#ISSthebiggerpicture
  
  
Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location.
  
  
Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. title: AI & Kubernetes Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

Role Overview
  
We are seeking an AI & Kubernetes Engineer to design, build, and optimize our infrastructure by leveraging AI tools, specifically Cursor AI. Core Responsibilities

•    On-Demand Skill Modification: Make real-time, on-demand modifications and iterative improvements to Cursor skills to resolve immediate development bottlenecks.

•    Tech-Agnostic Project Execution: Utilize AI to rapidly adapt to, develop for, and execute projects across any technology stack or programming language required by the business.
  
•    AI-Driven Project Lifecycles: Leverage AI tools to accelerate the entire project lifecycle, from initial architecture and code generation to testing, cross-functional deployment, and documentation.
  
•    Kubernetes Orchestration: Deploy, scale, and manage Kubernetes clusters while using your customized AI workflows to generate manifests, Helm charts, and K8s configurations.
  
•    AI Tool Optimization: Continually refine how the AI interacts with your codebase, feeding relevant documentation, schemas, and cluster configurations into Cursor for highly accurate outputs.
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
•    Advanced Cursor AI Mastery: Proven experience not just using Cursor, but deeply managing, editing, and creating advanced Cursor behaviors, custom skills, and workspace rules.
  
•    AI Logic & Context Engineering: Strong understanding of defining AI constraints, feeding project-specific context, and fine-tuning AI behavior through configuration.
  
•    Polyglot & Adaptive Mindset: Proven ability to use AI as a force multiplier to quickly master and deliver robust code in unfamiliar technical environments, frameworks, or legacy systems.
  
•    Kubernetes Expertise: Deep knowledge of Kubernetes architecture, kubectl, Helm, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  
•    DevOps Automation: Experience integrating AI-optimized code and scripts into modern CI/CD pipelines.

Mandatory Skills: DevOps
  
.

Experience: 5-8 Years
  
.

title: Senior Administrator, Systems
description:

Senior Administrator, Systems

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**About the job :**

Complyance is a fast-growing e-invoicing and tax compliance SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding their finance systems every time a regulation changes.

We have built a strong base in MENA and India, our platform is live across 10+ jurisdictions, and we are now expanding into Europe and the US.

We are building a developer-first e-invoicing platform for businesses, enterprises and ecosystem partners: secure, dependable APIs and integrations, with an exceptional developer and customer experience.

**Life at Complyance :**

We are a lean, high-ownership team that cares about doing the basics exceptionally well. Our work is visible, our decisions matter, and we are looking for people who want to shape how a company grows, not just keep it running.

**The mission :**

This is not a role for managing from the sidelines. You will be the hands-on engineering leader who shapes our technology platform, builds a high-performing team and sets the engineering practices needed to scale a regulated, transaction-focused SaaS business.

You will report to the CTO and work closely with the founders and product leadership, with direct influence over product architecture, engineering culture and team formation. You will stay technically engaged: in architecture reviews, design discussions and the critical technical decisions.

**Where you’ll leave your mark :**

**•**
**Set the engineering direction:**

 Own engineering strategy and execution for our e-invoicing platform, including the technical roadmap, architecture decisions and the management of technical debt.

**•**
**Build APIs people trust:**

 Own the architecture and delivery of secure, scalable APIs, SDKs, webhooks and enterprise integrations, and the developer experience around them.

**•**
**Keep the platform reliable:**

 Own reliability, availability, observability, security and production operations.

**•**
**Grow the team:**

 Lead engineering hiring, mentoring, performance and team development.

**•**
**Raise the engineering bar:**

 Run the practices that keep quality high: design reviews, testing, releases, incident response and postmortems.

**•**
**Work across the business:**

 Collaborate with product, customer success, implementation, compliance and enterprise customers.

**The kind of leader we’re looking for :**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

**•**

Have 8–12 years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams.

**•**

Have a strong background in backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms and API design.

**•**

Are tech-savvy, with a strong command of advanced technologies and modern engineering tools.

**•**

Have built or operated high-volume, transaction-oriented SaaS platforms.

**•**

Can manage, coach and grow high-performing engineers.

**•**

Know production reliability, observability, incident management and secure software delivery.

**•**

Bring strong product thinking, execution discipline and customer orientation.

**•**

Are comfortable in a fast-moving startup with ambiguity and significant ownership.

**•**

Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation.

And as a person, you:

**•**

Combine people leadership with strong technical judgement.

**•**

Operate with high ownership and low ego.

**•**

Make pragmatic decisions with limited time and resources.

**•**

Move comfortably between architecture, hiring, delivery, customers and production issues.

**•**

Build simple, reliable systems rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.

**•**

Care deeply about API quality, security, documentation and developer experience.

**Bonus points :**

**•**

Experience in payments, fintech, invoicing, tax technology, accounting, ERP or compliance platforms.

**•**

Experience with external APIs, SDKs, webhooks, authentication, rate limiting, versioning, retries and idempotency.

**•**

Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and enterprise integration architecture.

**•**

Experience handling sensitive financial or business information.

**•**

Experience with government, tax-authority, Peppol or other regulated-network integrations.

**•**

Experience at a FAANG company (Facebook/Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix or Google), Amazon/AWS, or another high-scale product engineering organisation. This is an added advantage, not a requirement.

**Why Complyance?**

**•**

Competitive base salary. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**•**

Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family and paid time off.

**•**

The chance to build for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.

**•**

A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

**How to apply**

* Apply on LinkedIn, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit. Please include the candidate’s current location, notice period, present role and LinkedIn profile.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Moative

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

**Our Past**

: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

**Team**

: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders. This role leads technology for our healthcare business, working alongside forward-deployed engineers, data scientists and revenue cycle operators to build an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices.

Work you’ll do

We are building an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. We combine operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue cycle and administrative workflows. We automate suitable tasks progressively, with clear controls and human accountability for exceptions and consequential decisions.

As CTO, you will own the technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering organization behind this business. You will work with our founders, practice owners and billing leaders to decide what to build, which workflows to prioritize and how to measure results. You will remain hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and difficult production problems.

You will build a reusable platform that connects practice systems, supports reliable automation and captures operational learning across engagements, while maintaining appropriate separation of each practice’s data. The work includes payer-portal agents, voice-based payer follow-up, claim-journey analysis, denial management and payment-posting workflows.

Technical leads will own day-to-day pod delivery within the direction you set. You will resolve major technical trade-offs, develop those leaders and remain accountable for platform quality, reliability and technical risk.

Responsibilities

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO.
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, establish baselines and prioritize investments by business value, feasibility and dependencies.
* Lead product and platform decisions, balancing practice-specific requirements with capabilities that can be reused across customers and specialties.
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, connecting data pipelines, AI agents and operator workflows.
* Define the practice data architecture, integrating claims, remittances, EOBs, denial codes and operational records into validated, traceable data with clear access controls and isolation between practices.
* Separate operational data that requires patient identifiers from de-identified analytical datasets, and define approved uses of each.
* Stay hands-on through architecture and code reviews, targeted prototypes and resolution of complex production issues.
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions based on reliability, security, cost and business value.
* Establish technical controls for healthcare privacy, security and compliance, working with legal, compliance and client stakeholders on approved data flows, retention, vendor access and incident response.
* Set production evaluation and release criteria, including monitoring, human escalation, recovery procedures and ownership of failures.
* Own engineering and infrastructure budgets, platform operating costs and investment in reusable capabilities.
* Hire, develop and retain engineers, data scientists and technical leads, with clear accountability for quality and delivery.
* Represent Moative’s technology with practice owners, partners and investors, explaining technical choices and their implications for practice economics.

Who you are

You are a technology leader who has built products and remains close to engineering. You can decide what to build with a practice owner, examine an architecture with an engineer and explain investment choices to an executive or investor.

You have worked with fragmented operational systems, inconsistent data and workflows that depend on people’s judgment. You investigate how work is actually done before deciding what to automate, and you understand that reliable data and clear processes are foundations for useful AI.

You have built and scaled products or a technology business, made decisions with incomplete information and stayed accountable for customer adoption and commercial outcomes. You can develop strong technical leaders while stepping into difficult engineering problems when needed.

You want to build the technology foundation of an AI MSO and take responsibility for how it performs as the business grows.

Skills & Requirements

Must have

* At least 15 years of relevant engineering and technology leadership experience, with recent hands-on involvement in architecture, solution design, prototyping and production troubleshooting.
* Experience building and scaling a product or technology business in a founding, CTO or senior engineering leadership role, with clear evidence of customer adoption, commercial outcomes and your own contribution.
* Experience owning product and technology decisions from customer discovery through production, adoption and ongoing improvement.
* Deep experience integrating, cleaning and modeling fragmented operational data, including building reusable platforms serving multiple customers with clear data isolation and access boundaries.
* Experience leading teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM-based applications or agents, with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation.
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture skills across at least one platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—with the ability to review code, challenge designs and build prototypes.
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with practical understanding of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting.
* Experience establishing technical controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response.
* Experience building engineering and data teams, hiring senior technical leaders and establishing engineering standards.
* Experience owning technology budgets, vendor decisions and operating costs, and explaining investment trade-offs in business terms.
* Experience working directly with CXOs, founders and investors to agree priorities, resolve conflicting expectations and communicate technical risk.
* Ability to demonstrate a product you chose to build, the architecture and team you developed, the trade-offs you made and the results achieved.

Preferred experience

* Experience building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.
* Experience taking a company through an acquisition, merger or other successful exit, including technical diligence and transition responsibilities.
* Experience turning services engagements or client-specific solutions into reusable products and platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data exchange and integrations involving claims, remittances, EHRs, practice-management systems or clearinghouses.
* Experience with process mining, operational knowledge systems or adapting smaller models for domain-specific tasks.
* Experience building browser automation or voice agents for operational workflows.

**Location: Chennai or Bangalore.**

Chennai preferred. This role involves regular in-person collaboration with our founders and the healthcare AI pod.

Working at Moative

Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless. Here are some of our guiding principles:

* **Think in decades. Act in hours.**

  As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.
* **Own the canvas.**

  Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.
* **Use data or don’t use data.**

  Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.
* **Avoid work about work**

  . Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.
* **High revenue per person.**

  We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

We’d love to hear about a product you helped build and scale, ideally in healthcare or another regulated, data-intensive industry—covering the customer problem, key decisions, team, challenges, results, and your role. Founding or exit experience is welcome. Please share only authorized information; anonymized examples work well.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
  
  
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
  
  
As
**Senior Security Architect**
, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.
  
  
**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.

title: AI Security Architect - Hyperscaler & Cloud AI Platforms
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
  
  
**About The Role**
As an
**AI Security Architect - Hyperscaler & Cloud AI Platforms**
, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be a key member of the
**AI Security Engineering & Enablement (AISE)**
team, collaborating with IT AI Architects, business unit solution teams, platform engineering teams, cloud security stakeholders, and hyperscaler architects. You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and improve workflows while upholding our commitment to quality and continuous learning. As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact with our vibrant people and culture while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own and maintain AI security reference architectures across Azure, AWS, and GCP AI service stacks, covering deployment patterns, network boundaries, identity, data flows, and guardrail integrations.
* Define and maintain security baselines for AI platforms and services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, and GCP Gemini services.
* Conduct STRIDE-based threat modelling for hyperscaler AI platforms and develop platform-specific security controls, standards, and implementation requirements.
* Co-design secure AI solutions with IT AI Architects and delivery teams, providing architecture guidance, security blueprints, design reviews, and security sign-off as formal AISE deliverables.
* Lead the development of AI-native security patterns, including identity architectures, data protection controls, AI supply chain security requirements, guardrail integration blueprints, and secure infrastructure deployment models.

Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, and commit to continuous learning. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* 10+ years of experience in cloud security architecture, including at least 3 years focused on AI/ML security within public cloud environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with at least two of the following platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Amazon Bedrock, or Vertex AI, including security configuration, network isolation, and identity architecture design.
* Proven experience developing and implementing enterprise-scale cloud security reference architectures and technical security standards.
* Strong threat modelling expertise using STRIDE and familiarity with MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM Top 10 as applied to cloud-hosted AI systems.
* Experience designing identity architectures for AI workloads, including managed identities, OAuth 2.0 client credentials flows, workload identity federation, RBAC, and ABAC models.
* Strong understanding of cloud data security controls, including encryption, data residency requirements, tokenization, VPC architectures, and private endpoint designs.
* Experience addressing AI supply chain risks, including model provenance, software bills of materials (SBOM), dependency management, and model registry security.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation and integrating security requirements into infrastructure delivery pipelines.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.

**These will help you succeed**

* Experience implementing prompt injection defenses and guardrail controls at the platform or API gateway layer, including Azure APIM content filtering, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, or Vertex AI safety controls.
* Experience securing agentic AI workflows and multi-agent orchestration platforms, including LangGraph, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
* Industry certifications such as AZ-500, SC-100, AWS Security Specialty, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent credentials.
* Familiarity with AI-specific detection and telemetry capabilities, including Azure Monitor AI logging, CloudTrail monitoring for Bedrock workloads, and Vertex AI audit logging.
* Experience in consulting, managed security services, product security, or enterprise AI adoption programs operating at scale.
* Ability to influence technical design decisions and collaborate effectively with hyperscaler solution architects and engineering teams.

**Work model – Hybrid**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a Cognizant or client office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Senior AI & Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) provides expert security advisory services to Sales, Pre-Sales, Customers, and Partners. The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior
**AI Cloud Security Architect**
to join the Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) as a technical Security Subject Matter Expert (SME). This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.
  
  
As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.
  
  
This role is highly consultative and requires excellent English communication and presentation skills. You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. You must be comfortable presenting complex technical security concepts to audiences ranging from security practitioners and architects to CISOs, CIOs, and other senior executives, both remotely and in person, to any of our global customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead customer-facing security discussions with customers, prospects, partners, auditors, and internal stakeholders on Genesys Cloud architecture, penetration testing, vulnerability management, remediation, privacy, compliance, and AI security.
* Provide technical consulting that maps Genesys Cloud security capabilities and controls to customer security, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
* Develop, validate, and present technical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of controls across identity and access management, encryption, key management, network security, logging, monitoring, incident response, application security, AI security, and secure software development.
* Deliver technical deep dives, security workshops, and executive briefings for audiences ranging from security practitioners and auditors to CISOs, CIOs, and senior business leaders.
* Own complex customer security, privacy, and compliance matters and contractual security negotiations.
* Represent Genesys at strategic customer engagements, partner events, conferences, webinars, and industry forums across APAC, contributing to external security thought leadership.

**This Role Offers**

* A highly technical, customer-facing Cloud Security Architect role within a global Centre of Excellence.
* Collaboration with Engineering, Product Security, Architecture, Privacy, Compliance, and AI teams.
* Exposure to complex enterprise cloud environments and leading global customer security organisations.
* The opportunity to shape customer trust in Genesys Cloud and its AI capabilities through technical assurance, executive engagement, and industry representation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ experience cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, security architecture, or related technical security disciplines.
* Strong practical expertise in AWS security, cloud-native architectures, APIs, Kubernetes, and modern SaaS security models.
* Proven experience designing, securing, operating, or assessing enterprise cloud environments and cloud-native applications.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, conversational AI, or other AI-enabled application architectures, including their security and data-protection risks.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI security threats and controls, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency, model and tool abuse, identity and authorization risks, and AI supply-chain dependencies.
* Experience applying recognized AI security guidance, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Agentic AI security guidance.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, encryption, data protection, API security, vulnerability management, threat modelling, and DevSecOps practices.
* Working understanding of privacy and compliance considerations associated with enterprise AI, particularly data handling, access, retention, transparency, governance, and third-party AI services.
* Experience supporting enterprise security assessments, technical due diligence, audits, customer assurance, or customer-facing security engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical security and AI concepts clearly to both highly technical teams and senior executives.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, securing, integrating, or operating enterprise virtual agents/assistants (AVAs), conversational AI, AI agents, or similar AI-powered customer experience solutions.
* Experience taking AI-enabled applications into production, including API/tool integrations, identity and authorization, data flows, guardrails, observability, monitoring, and operational security.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, threat modelling, AI security assessments, or model/application evaluation frameworks.
* Experience assessing AI systems against emerging AI governance, privacy, security, or regulatory requirements.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, security automation, CI/CD security, or cloud security engineering.
* Experience working with enterprise contact-centre, conversational AI, customer experience, or communications platforms.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, or comparable security certifications.
* Understanding of ISO/IEC 42001 and AI management system principles.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work

title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to focus primarily on capacity and demand planning across data centers and public cloud. You will combine practical infrastructure experience with analytical thinking and strong internal customer relationships to translate future demand into clear capacity models, options, and timely decisions. This is a hands-on planning role grounded in how production infrastructure actually performs.
  
  
You will proactively engage engineering, application, product, and business teams, and help drive capacity and cost discussions with our existing FinOps engineers. Leadership owns approved forecasts, procurement and investment recommendations and decisions, and team backlog priorities. You provide the evidence, facilitate the planning cadence, and surface issues early.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build trusted relationships and proactive demand intake with internal customers, connecting delivery plans, workload changes, and business growth to infrastructure needs.
* Develop headroom, runway, growth, and scenario models for data center and public cloud capacity, documenting assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, and changes in demand.
* Validate sizing against production evidence, peak demand, failover conditions, and performance requirements, rather than treating average utilization as sufficient.
* Account for hardware lifecycle and procurement lead times, cloud quotas, regional availability, and provisioning constraints when developing timing and capacity options.
* Run a leadership-sponsored planning cadence, maintain clear analytical inputs, and escalate approved threshold crossings for review. Thresholds trigger discussion, not automatic purchases.
* Help drive FinOps discussions with existing FinOps engineers: facilitate consumption, demand, capacity, and cost conversations; support consumption and spend forecast scenarios; and follow up with agreed action owners without controlling their backlogs.
* Partner on rightsizing, reclamation, total cost of ownership, workload placement, and commitment analysis. Validate potential savings against resilience and performance needs; FinOps specialists retain ownership of their practice and program.

**Requirements**

* Five or more years of practical infrastructure engineering or operations experience, with the technical depth and independent judgment expected of a senior engineer. We welcome candidates whose experience has been built in infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams in a global environment. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with the US Eastern business day is required.

**Technical Requirements**

* Practical understanding of virtualization, compute, operating systems, storage capacity and performance (IOPS, latency, and throughput), networks, and resilience. Experience with platforms such as VMware or Nutanix and Windows or Linux is relevant; specific vendors are not required.
* Ability to interpret observability and time-series data, assess public cloud capacity constraints, and build demand forecasts using Excel, SQL, Python, or equivalent data analysis tools.

**Working Experience With**

* Sizing production workloads and validating capacity assumptions against real telemetry, workload behavior, service objectives, and operational constraints.
* Translating cross-team demand into planning inputs and collaborating with globally distributed teams to resolve gaps, dependencies, and competing assumptions.

**Must-Have Capabilities**

* Personal, practical infrastructure depth: explain how resources, bottlenecks, failure modes, and workload behavior affect usable capacity.
* Translate customer demand into defensible forecasts and scenarios, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and risks.
* Facilitate constructive stakeholder conversations, challenge weak assumptions respectfully, and apply sound technical judgment to capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Collaborate effectively with FinOps engineers and service owners, making cost-aware options understandable without compromising performance or resilience.

**What This Role Is NOT**

* A general infrastructure delivery or ticket-queue role measured primarily by throughput, or a position intended to backfill on-call coverage. Operational experience informs the work; capacity and demand planning remain the primary focus.
* Ownership of approved forecasts, spend approval, procurement or investment recommendations and decisions, architecture, team backlog priorities, or the FinOps program. You develop analytical inputs and options in partnership with the accountable owners.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior specialist FinOps experience or certification, and experience supporting cloud cost optimization or commitment analysis. These are preferred, not required.
* Automation that improves telemetry collection, model inputs, or repeatable analysis. Terraform, Ansible, Git, CI/CD, and Kubernetes experience can be useful, but none is mandatory.

**How You'll Be Successful / Bottom Line**
You combine hands-on infrastructure knowledge with analytical judgment and strong working relationships to help our teams plan ahead. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.

title: IAM/C-IAM integration expert
description:
**Job Title:**
IAM/C-IAM integration expert
  
  
**Department**
: Tribe Core Capabilities (CARDIF IT Corporate) - SEC4APP domain, Frontdesk Squad
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
BNP Paribas Cardif is the insurance subsidiary of BNP Paribas. We are a worldwide leader of the Credit Protection Insurance market with strong positions in savings and protection insurance in more than 30 countries in Europe, Asia and Latin America.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Support Cardif international in IAM/C-IAM onboarding.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design & Implement SSO solutions using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) across internal and external applications.
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Keycloak realms and clients (confidential, public, bearer‑only) to meet business SSO requirements.
* Create and manage protocol mappers, role‑to‑group mappings, and attribute‑release policies in Keycloak to ensure correct claim propagation.
* Integrate third‑party IdPs (Azure AD, Okta, ADFS, Google, etc.) and service providers (SPs) via SAML metadata exchange and OIDC discovery.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts (Terraform, or Helm) for repeatable Keycloak deployments in Kubernetes or VM environments.
* Perform security reviews and hardening of authentication flows (e.g., signing/encryption algorithms, token lifetimes, PKCE, JWS/JWE).
* Troubleshoot authentication failures, analyze SAML assertions and OIDC ID/access tokens using tools like SAML‑Tracer, jwt.io.
* Document architecture, runbooks, and SOPs for onboarding new applications and de‑provisioning legacy services.
* Collaborate with development, DevSecOps, and compliance teams to align IAM practices with GDPR, SOC 2 and internal policies.
* Provide on‑call support for critical authentication incidents; lead post‑mortems and drive continuous improvement.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Design & Implement SSO solutions using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) across internal and external applications.
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Keycloak realms and clients (confidential, public, bearer‑only) to meet business SSO requirements.
* Create and manage protocol mappers, role‑to‑group mappings, and attribute‑release policies in Keycloak to ensure correct claim propagation.
* Integrate third‑party IdPs (Azure AD, Okta, ADFS, Google, etc.) and service providers (SPs) via SAML metadata exchange and OIDC discovery.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts (Terraform, or Helm) for repeatable Keycloak deployments in Kubernetes or VM environments.
* Perform security reviews and hardening of authentication flows (e.g., signing/encryption algorithms, token lifetimes, PKCE, JWS/JWE).
* Troubleshoot authentication failures, analyze SAML assertions and OIDC ID/access tokens using tools like SAML‑Tracer, jwt.io.
* Document architecture, runbooks, and SOPs for onboarding new applications and de‑provisioning legacy services.
* Collaborate with development, DevSecOps, and compliance teams to align IAM practices with GDPR, SOC 2 and internal policies.
* Provide on‑call support for critical authentication incidents; lead post‑mortems and drive continuous improvement.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Identity Protocols: SAML 2.0 (metadata, assertions, bindings), OpenID Connect (Authorization Code, Implicit, Hybrid, PKCE)
* Keycloak: Realm & client setup, authentication flows, custom SPI extensions, admin REST API, theme customization
* Programming / Scripting: Java (for custom Keycloak providers), Bash for automation, Groovy (optional)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm charts, Docker/Kubernetes (deployment of Keycloak)
* Security: JWT signing/encryption, X.509 certificates, OAuth 2.0 scopes, token revocation, MFA integration (TOTP, WebAuthn)
* Networking & Web: HTTPS/TLS, reverse proxies (NGINX, HAProxy, Apache), load balancers, DNS
* Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK stack, Keycloak event listeners
* Version Control & CI/CD: Git, GitLab/GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD
* Documentation: Confluence, Markdown, Swagger/OpenAPI (for custom endpoints)

**Specific Qualifications**

* Professional Experience: 5–10 years in IAM, SSO, or security engineering with a focus on SAML/OIDC implementations.
* Keycloak Expertise: Proven track record configuring and scaling Keycloak in production (≥ 2 years).

* Keycloak
* Programming / Scripting
* Infrastructure as Code
* Security
* Networking & Web
* Monitoring & Logging
* Version Control & CI/CD
* Documentation

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong analytical mindset,
* ability to work cross‑functionally and mentor junior staff.

**Transversal Skills**

* excellent written/oral communication,

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field

equivalent professional experience

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. title: Cloud Architect
description:
The AWS AI Architect defines and owns the technical architecture for enterprise AI and GenAI solutions, from data foundations and model selection through deployment, governance, and monitoring. You work with business, data, engineering, and risk teams to turn use cases into scalable, secure, compliant production systems. Lead the design and development of our cloud-native applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, turning complex requirements into resilient, secure, and cost-effective distributed systems. You will work closely with software developers, cloud engineers, and product owners to build high-performance applications leveraging modern AWS services.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Design end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI architectures (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, model serving) that integrate with existing enterprise platforms.
* Evaluate and select LLMs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and MLOps tooling.
* Define reference architectures, patterns, and standards for reuse across teams.
* Partner with data engineering on pipelines, feature stores, and data quality for AI workloads.
* Build in responsible AI: model risk management, explainability, bias testing, audit trails, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish MLOps/LLMOps practices covering CI/CD, evaluation, observability, drift detection, and cost control.
* Lead proofs of concept and pilots, and move them to production.
* Advise stakeholders and executives on AI strategy, feasibility, and trade-offs.
* Mentor engineers and data scientists, and run architecture reviews.

**Required qualifications:**

* 10+ years in software or data engineering, with 4+ years architecting AI/ML solutions in production.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Strong Python skills and fluency in ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Deep experience with at least AWS cloud sand its AI services (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI).
* Application Design: Design scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-availability cloud applications using core AWS services like Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and DynamoD
* Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
* Solid grounding in data architecture: data lakes/warehouses, streaming, APIs, and microservices.
* Knowledge of security, privacy, and governance for AI systems.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in banking, insurance, or asset/wealth management, including regulatory expectations (e.g., SR 11-7 model risk).
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and fine-tuning or evaluation frameworks.
* Cloud or architecture certifications (e.g., AWS ML Specialty, AWS AI Engineer, TOGAF).
* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

title: Manager - Azure Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Lead/Principal Azure Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, standardization, and operation of enterprise Azure infrastructure at scale. This is a technical leadership role responsible for landing zone and platform architecture, automation and governance frameworks, reliability and cost optimization, and for guiding engineering teams and engaging with senior stakeholders and vendors.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead the design and implementation of Azure landing zones, subscription/management-group structures, and platform foundations aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework.
* Define and own infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and reusable Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) modules consumed across teams.
* Architect and govern networking and connectivity at scale — hub-and-spoke/Virtual WAN, VPN/ExpressRoute, routing, DNS, private endpoints, IPAM, and egress/SASE controls — within Azure platform service limits.
* Establish governance, security, and compliance frameworks — Azure Policy guardrails, RBAC and identity models, Key Vault/secrets strategy, tagging, and baseline security controls.
* Drive reliability engineering — HA/DR design, backup strategy, capacity and quota planning, observability, and performance/availability SLOs.
* Own cloud cost governance (FinOps) — optimization strategy, budgeting, rightsizing, and chargeback/show back models.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of infrastructure programs and POCs, including orchestration/automation initiatives and migration/consolidation efforts.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers; conduct architecture and code reviews; raise the team's engineering maturity.
* Engage with senior stakeholders, security/architecture review boards, and vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Zscaler) on design validation and roadmap.
* Evaluate emerging Azure services and tooling and define adoption recommendations and standards.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for high-impact incidents, and drive corrective/preventive actions.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* 6–10 years in cloud infrastructure, with deep, hands-on Azure expertise and a track record of designing and operating at enterprise scale.
* Strong architecture experience across Azure compute, storage, networking, identity (Entra ID), and key PaaS services.
* Expert-level Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) — module/framework design, CI/CD integration, and policy-as-code (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions).
* Proven experience with landing zones, multi-subscription governance, and management-group design.
* Deep networking knowledge — hybrid connectivity, routing/BGP, segmentation, DNS, IPAM, and egress control; awareness of service limits and capacity planning.
* Strong grasp of cloud security, zero-trust principles, governance, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience leading delivery and mentoring engineers; strong stakeholder communication.
* Scripting/automation proficiency (PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python).

**These will help you succeed**

* Multi-cloud exposure (AWS and/or GCP) and multi-cloud governance experience.
* Experience with containers/AKS, GitOps, and platform-engineering practices.
* Familiarity with egress/SASE tooling (e.g., Zscaler) and large-scale IP remediation.
* Exposure to orchestration-based provisioning and subscription-vending automation.
* Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure Network Engineer (AZ-700), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or equivalent.

**Work Model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Bangalore/Coimbatore. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

title: Digital Software Lead Analyst
description:
The Digital S/W Eng Lead Analyst is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Accountable for executing and driving results on large-scale efforts or multiple smaller efforts and serving as a development lead for most medium and large projects. This includes expertise with application development methodologies and standards for program analysis, design, coding, testing, debugging and implementation.
* Accountable for exhibiting a strong understanding of client core business functions.
* Required to support situations in which end user consultation is required to identify system function specifications and incorporate them into overall system design and delivery. Additionally, utilize comprehensive knowledge of multiple areas within technology to achieve technological objectives.
* Independent work style, requiring little or no guidance by more senior developers. Decisions will make a significant, measurable impact on the business goals for the client organization. During team discussions you will play a significant role with TPMs and engineering managers to determine potential risks to a schedule.
* Assist in the planning and managing of application development assignments generally involving large budgets, cross functional projects or multiple projects. This includes effectively understanding and analyzing both technical and business risks and impact.
* Expected to effectively communicate those risks to the business owners, so that they can make informed decisions.
* Accountable for providing guidance on architecturally significant efforts during the preplanning phase, and ensuring principles and best practices are followed prior to initiation of work. In doing so, closely watch and evaluate Digital roadmaps, including impacts to support upcoming journeys.
* Publish design review extensions, and provide documented guidance aligned to sprint plans and timelines.
* Be part of the design review board that will focus on the design process, search for generic patterns, and, at the same time, share best practices across the organization.
* Publish design patterns across lines of business and domain commonalities. Drive design reviews for Next Gen Architecture (NGA) and Plan of Record (POR) projects, supporting design principles and best practices.
* Participate in micro services and NGA code reviews.
* Empower SDEs and their teams by mentoring and coaching.
* Have a comprehensive understanding of the business domain, the systems, and the products in your space. Understand their accountabilities, boundaries, limitations, scale factors and the reasons behind architectural decisions.
* Provide a long-term perspective for business and technology choices; using technical judgment to vet architecture as required.
* Able to direct teams on how to develop and deliver systems that are efficient with resource usage such as hardware, runtime, performance, load, and memory requirements.
* Responsible for broader design decisions and development of long-term strategies that significantly influence the development process and standards.
* Accountable for Design Reviews of Agile and Plan of Record (POR) projects as well as accountable for Code Reviews of Next Gen Architecture (NGA) projects and are expected to elaborate, promote and communicate Design Patterns applicable to NGA architectures and solutions.
* Accountable for providing architectural guidance to the SDE’s based on best practices and in alignment with CTO guidelines and platform.
* Drive clarity and work with complete independence as business and or technical strategy is not defined.
* Provide the corresponding architectural guidance, and conduct design reviews and code reviews based on the projects assigned to your LOB. The product definition and technical planning is out of scope.
* Accountable for the overall strategy and for driving the teams inside and outside of your organization to deliver expected results. Drive mindful discussion with business and technical stakeholders that lead to timely decisions. Participate in discussions to drive smart trade-off decisions that balance efforts, delivery timelines, features, and technical constraints. Identify and remove blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations.
* Create plans that have a clear path to delivery. Solve for dependencies between agile and waterfall delivery efforts. Help your teams organize for delivery while maximizing resources for the greater good of the Digital organization. Understand engineering best practices and apply best practices to the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
* Accountable for Design Reviews for Citi Agile and POR projects as well as Code Reviews for the NGA projects. Accountable for providing architectural guidance to the SDE’s based on best practices and in alignment with CTO guidelines and platform. Elaborate, promote and communicate Design Patterns applicable to NGA architectures and solutions.
* Elaborate, bring and communicate clear metrics on Design Reviews, Code Reviews, CI/CD and Design Patterns adoption.
* Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels. Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them.
* Demonstrate the ability to implement continuous improvement and the induction of new technology. Demonstrate examples of influence in scrum teams beyond your own area of focus.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

:

* 10+ years of hands-on experience is required
* Strong core Java experience, Spring Boot, Spring Security, OAuth
* Hands on experience in building enterprise level apps using Oracle DB, Mongo DB
* Experience working with build tools such as Gradle and Maven, build platforms such as Harness.
* Solid Linux/Unix skills

At Trane TechnologiesTM and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient environments, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.
  
  
Why consider this role
  
  
As the Data & AI Delivery Leader, you will drive high-impact initiatives that deliver tangible business value through a balanced mix of architectural strategy and hands-on execution. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of modern data platforms, generative AI, and intelligent automation while collaborating across business and technology teams to shape scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. This is an exceptional opportunity for a problem-solver who enjoys influencing technical direction, mentoring engineers, and establishing practical patterns that elevate long-term delivery quality.
  
  
**Thrive At Work And At Home**

* Inclusive Wellbeing Program, with resources to support your and your family’s physical, social, emotional, and financial well-being.
* Comprehensive learning and development solutions, designed to support our people in connecting and growing, including Higher education/Certification reimbursement.
* Sense of belonging & community through our Employee Resource Groups that foster our culture of inclusion.
* Volunteerism: 8 hours of paid time off per calendar year to volunteer with non-profit charitable organizations.
* The Trane Technologies Helping Hands Fund to support employees facing financial challenges due to unforeseen personal hardship.

Where is the work
  
  
Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India.
  
  
Work Arrangement - Hybrid: This position has been designated as a Hybrid work schedule, with work performed on-site 4 days each week.
  
  
What's in it for you
  
  

* Lead architecture and delivery for strategic enterprise Data and AI initiatives in a role that is intentionally hands-on, with direct impact on scalable, secure, high-quality business outcomes.
* Shape enterprise data foundations, analytics architecture, AI/ML enablement, generative AI, knowledge retrieval, and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Influence end-to-end solution direction, enterprise standards, and reusable architecture patterns across the organization.
* Build long-term Data and AI capability across the team and broader organization through mentoring, coaching, reusable playbooks, and practical knowledge transfer.

**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end architecture for Data and AI solutions aligned to enterprise strategy, business goals, and platform standards, while remaining hands-on in key solution areas.
* Define scalable, secure, and reusable architecture patterns across data ingestion, transformation, modelling, semantic layers, analytics, AI/ML, and generative AI components.
* Translate business capability needs into architecture blueprints, technical decisions, and implementation direction.
* Lead delivery execution across product, engineering, governance, security, and business teams from concept through implementation, while maintaining a reasonable percentage of direct involvement in solution shaping and critical execution decisions.
* Shape new initiatives by defining scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and high-level estimates.
* Drive architecture and delivery decisions across multiple concurrent efforts while balancing speed, quality, risk, sustainability, and value realization.
* Guide data architecture across cloud-native platforms including lake, warehouse, semantic, and consumption layers, and ensure governed, reusable data models aligned to business definitions.
* Lead design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise AI assistants, knowledge retrieval, intelligent workflow automation, and predictive analytics use cases.
* Establish practical delivery and evaluation patterns for AI solutions from experimentation through production rollout, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for governance, security, privacy, responsible AI, operational readiness, and supportability.
* Act as a key interface across business stakeholders, product leaders, governance leaders, engineering teams, and enterprise technology leadership, while actively building team capability through mentoring, coaching, and practical knowledge transfer.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, data architecture, enterprise data platforms, analytics delivery, AI solution design, or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong experience leading end-to-end solution design and delivery for complex data, analytics, and AI initiatives in enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of cloud data platforms, preferably GCP / BigQuery or equivalent enterprise cloud ecosystems.
* Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, semantic design, analytical solution patterns, and governed data foundations.
* Practical experience designing or leading enterprise AI solutions, including generative AI, knowledge retrieval, AI assistants, or ML-enabled decision-support capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise data platform thinking with AI solution delivery and business adoption.
* Experience guiding cross-functional teams across architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, security, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, security, responsible AI, and enterprise standards.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and lead through change.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience supporting enterprise AI assistants, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge retrieval, or similar Data and AI solution patterns.
* Experience defining AI governance guardrails, model risk controls, or responsible AI practices in an enterprise setting.
* Familiarity with metadata, data catalog, governance, vector search, or knowledge platform capabilities.
* Experience with Git-based delivery practices, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern engineering standards for data and AI platforms.
* Exposure to domain-oriented data product principles and federated delivery models.
* Experience helping scale AI adoption through reusable patterns, playbooks, delivery frameworks, or platform enablement.

Serve as senior technical escalation point and mentor to engineers
  
  
Drive innovation by proposing and piloting emerging network technologies

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Required: Fortinet NSE 4 minimum
  
  
Strongly preferred: NSE 7 (Enterprise Firewall or SD-WAN) or higher
  
  
Preferred: AWS, Azure, or other cloud networking certification

Significant production experience with Fortinet in complex, multi-site environments

Deep, hands-on Fortinet expertise: FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and Fortinet SD-WAN
