title: Associate Director - AI Delivery Product
description:
**Job Summary**
About Firstsource
  
  
Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.
  
  
We are seeking a commercially astute and technically exceptional Associate Director to bridge client relationships and world-class AI & Cloud engineering delivery. You will be the primary interface between strategic clients and our engineering teams - winning new mandates, co-designing solutions, and owning end-to-end delivery from ideation to production. With 15+ years of experience, you bring deep Python and Generative AI expertise, proven cloud architecture skills, and the gravitas to influence at the C-suite level while staying hands-on with modern agentic development tooling.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Architecture & Solutioning
  
  

* Translate ambiguous client needs into structured, costed, and deliverable technical roadmaps.
* Architect end-to-end solutions: from ideation and PoC through to scalable production systems.
* Drive cloud-native design on Azure, AWS, GCP or hybrid platforms.
* Define reference architectures embedding Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic workflows.

Engineering Leadership & Delivery
  
  

* Lead multi-disciplinary teams of 10-20 engineers, leads, and architects across geographies.
* Establish and enforce delivery governance: agile rituals, quality gates, and risk management.
* Champion CI/CD, DevSecOps, and MLOps practices across all client programmes.
* Own program P&L, resource planning, and executive-level status reporting.
* Drive adoption of AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon Q) to accelerate delivery.

Generative AI & Intelligent Automation
  
  

* Embed Generative AI capabilities (LLMs, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems) into enterprise products.
* Design and deploy AI agent workflows using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar platforms.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging agentic frameworks (LangChain, Agent Core, CrewAI, etc.) to accelerate delivery.
* Champion responsible AI practices including governance, safety, and model observability.

People & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Build, mentor, and grow a high-performance team of engineers and technical managers.
* Manage a complex stakeholder matrix: internal leadership, client sponsors, and delivery partners.
* Influence without authority across business units and geographies.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years in software / AI engineering; 6+ years at senior leadership or Associate Director level.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Demonstrated track record of building and shipping end-to-end applications across the full SDLC.
* Full lifecycle ownership: ideation → architecture → engineering → production → optimisation.
* Proven cloud architecture and deployment across at least one hyperscaler.
* Demonstrable track record of winning and delivering large-scale client engagements.
* Strong commercial acumen: P&L ownership, proposal writing, SOW and contract management.

title: AI Architect

description:
Location: Remote – India (Chennai preferred)

Company: Steps Software Solutions Private Limited

**Role Description**

This is a remote role supporting the growth of Steps Software Solutions’ Azure Databricks and data engineering services. Candidates anywhere in India are welcome to apply, with a preference for those based in Chennai who can join occasional in-person meetings and local industry events. The Business Development Associate will work directly with the leadership team to generate opportunities, build relationships with prospects and partners, and support the sales process from first contact through to signed engagements.

Day-to-day responsibilities include researching and building target account lists of companies with active Azure Databricks needs (migrations, pipeline development, cost optimization, governance, or implementation support); conducting outbound outreach via email, phone, and LinkedIn to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Data, and Data Engineering Managers; booking and joining discovery calls; preparing briefing notes before calls and capturing requirements after them; and following up with prospects in a structured way.

The role also supports partner development, including reaching out to larger Databricks and Azure consulting partners for subcontracting opportunities and helping maintain relationships with Databricks and Microsoft field teams. The BDA will assist with preparing proposals and presentations, keeping CRM and pipeline records accurate, registering opportunities in the Databricks Partner Portal, and creating sales content such as LinkedIn posts and case study drafts.

This is a learning-focused role. The BDA will receive training on Databricks, Azure data services, and consultative selling, and will gradually take ownership of more of the sales cycle, with a clear path to a Business Development Manager role for strong performers.

Success in this position is measured by qualified meetings held, pipeline generated, partner conversations opened, and contribution to closed deals.

**Compensation**

Fixed monthly stipend or salary plus performance incentives, discussed during interview. Incentives include a payment for each qualified meeting that takes place and a bonus on deals the BDA sourced or helped close.

What counts as a “Qualified Meeting” (for incentive purposes):

The meeting actually took place (no-shows don’t count)

The attendee is a decision-maker or strong influencer: CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Data, Data Engineering Manager, or equivalent

The company fits our target profile, roughly 50–500 employees or as otherwise specified, and is a plausible buyer of Azure Databricks or data engineering services

The prospect described a real, relevant problem during the call, such as migration challenges, pipeline issues, cost overruns, or scaling problems

Meeting notes, attendee title, company details, and stated pain point are logged in CRM

Meetings with partner companies that lead to subcontracting or co-selling discussions also count. If there’s any ambiguity, we’ll review together.

**Qualifications**

0–3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, inside sales, or lead generation; freshers with strong communication skills and genuine interest in tech sales are welcome

Alternatively, 1–3 years as a data engineer, analyst, or technical consultant interested in moving into business development or presales

Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to senior technical stakeholders

Basic understanding of, or strong willingness to learn, cloud and data concepts such as Databricks, Azure, Spark, and data pipelines (training will be provided)

Organized and self-driven, able to manage outreach, follow-ups, and targets while working remotely

Comfortable with CRM tools, LinkedIn, spreadsheets, and presentation software

Curious, coachable, and open to feedback

A degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is an advantage

**Responsibilities**

* Apply Databricks Unity Catalog to define and enforce governance policies including fine grained data permissions and standardized metadata so that data assets remain compliant and consistently discoverable across domains.

* Integrate data engineering solutions with Azure DevOps by configuring repositories branching strategies and automated deployment pipelines that promote continuous integration practices and reduce manual release risks.

* Document data flows transformation logic and operational procedures in clear technical artifacts that help other team members understand system behavior and support sustainable long term maintenance of solutions.
* Optimize compute cluster configurations and job parameters within Databricks to balance performance and cost ensuring that data workloads run effectively during day shift windows and align with capacity planning goals.
* Coordinate effectively in a hybrid work setting using collaboration tools and scheduled on site interactions maintaining consistent communication on progress risks and dependencies without requiring travel commitments.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by reviewing existing data engineering practices proposing enhancements and implementing changes that elevate the reliability and societal impact of data driven products.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in Databricks Unity Catalog including designing catalog structures and permission models that support secure multi domain data governance in large scale environments.
* Show advanced proficiency with Azure Data Lake Store covering data layout strategies security controls and performance considerations that enable high throughput ingestion and processing patterns.
* Apply solid expertise in Azure DevOps for version control and pipeline automation including configuration of build and release workflows that support data engineering lifecycles and quality gates.

title: Network Architect
description:
We are seeking a Network Architect to help lead the strategic design, technical direction, and hands-on optimization of our enterprise network infrastructure. In this role, you will define network topology across data centers, cloud interconnects, and global office locations while driving network automation and robust security practices.

  

Because this role directly supports our US customer base and collaborates daily with US-based engineering leadership, fluent, executive-level English communication (written and spoken) is essential.

  

Location: Remote, India

  
Responsibilities
  

  
* Network Architecture & Strategy: Design, build, and evolve core network topologies, enterprise WAN/LAN, SD-WAN, and cloud connectivity to ensure maximum uptime, low latency, and high scalability.
  
* US Customer & Escalation Support: Serve as the senior technical authority for high-tier customer escalations, complex network troubleshooting, and critical cross-platform incidents.
  
* Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Drive network automation using Python, Ansible, and Terraform to streamline provisioning, configuration management, and operational workflows.
  
* Cloud & Datacenter Interconnects: Architect and manage hybrid-cloud networking solutions connecting on-premises data centers to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OpenStack).
  
* Performance & Telemetry: Implement and maintain enterprise monitoring, alerting, and capacity-planning systems to enforce strict SLAs and continuous optimization.
  
* Collaboration & Leadership: Partner with global DevOps, Security, and Product teams while providing technical guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers.
  
* Documentation & Compliance: Develop comprehensive network diagrams, disaster recovery blueprints, and operational standards.
  

  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  

  
* Experience: 8+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a Senior or Architect capacity.
  
* Communication: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to interface directly with US teams and customers.
  
* Networking Expertise: Deep hands-on mastery of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), switching, MPLS, VXLAN, and IPsec VPNs.
  
* Hardware & Platforms: Proven track record with enterprise-grade platforms (Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, F5, or Fortinet).
  
* Cloud & Automation: Strong experience with cloud networking (AWS DirectConnect / Azure ExpressRoute) and network scripting/automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform).
  
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  
Preferred Qualifications
  

  
* Advanced certifications such as CCIE, CCNP (Enterprise/Data Center), JNCIE, or AWS Certified Advanced Networking.
  
* Prior experience working in a global delivery model supporting US enterprise clients.

description:

 The WorkNEXT AI Tech Expert is the technical ambassador for WorkNEXT AI modules—owning end\-to\-end client engagement, discovery, solution design, demos, pilots, and technical enablement. **Technical Ownership**

**Customer Success \& Enablement**
* Create client\-facing technical collateral: solution briefs, runbooks, FAQs, architecture diagrams, ROI calculators.
* Train client admins and super\-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.

* Collaborate with Sales/Pre\-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.


**Client\-Facing**
* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.

**Mindset**
* Outcome\-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**
* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q\&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.


**Tools \& Tech Stack (Illustrative)**
* Cloud \& Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).
* Observability \& Evaluation: Prometheus/Grafana, MLflow, human eval tooling, prompt/version management.
* Security: OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, KMS, DLP; Responsible AI guardrails \& content filters.

We recruit, reward, and develop our people based on merit, regardless of race, nationality, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability. We value our people and treat everyone who works for or with Petrofac fairly and without discrimination.
   

  

 The world is re\-thinking its energy supply and energy security needs and planning for a phased transition to alternative energy sources. We are here to help our clients meet these evolving energy needs.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join us on this journey.
   

  

***Are you ready to bring the right energy to Petrofac and help us deliver a better future for everyone?***
**JOB TITLE:** 
**IT Lead \- Infrastructure**
**Role Purpose**
 The Infrastructure Lead is accountable for the successful design, delivery and transition of the Petrofac Emirates infrastructure, network and IT operations landscape as part of the Emirates Carve\-Out Programme.
   

  

 The role will provide leadership across the infrastructure workstream, ensuring that all solutions are aligned with the approved Emirates architecture, High Level Design (HLD), security standards and programme guiding principles. The individual will work closely with business, technical, security, application, procurement and managed service partners to ensure the infrastructure platform is delivered within agreed timelines, supports Day 1 operational readiness and enables a successful TSA exit.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture**
* Own the infrastructure workstream across network, cloud, operational tooling and managed services for the new Petrofac Emirates.
* Ensure all infrastructure decisions align with the approved Emirates HLD, target architecture and programme guiding principles.
* Act as the primary infrastructure technical authority within the programme, reviewing designs and challenging deviations from architecture standards.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions remain scalable, secure, supportable and aligned to the future Petrofac Emirates operating model.
* Support design governance and architecture review forums.


**Delivery \& Implementation**
* Lead the delivery of the Emirates infrastructure platform, including cloud infrastructure, networking, connectivity, identity dependencies, monitoring, backup, recovery and operational tooling.
* Ensure all infrastructure activities are delivered in accordance with programme plans, milestones and TSA exit timelines.
* Coordinate internal teams, vendors and managed service providers to achieve successful implementation outcomes.
* Oversee infrastructure testing, service validation, operational readiness and transition into support.
* Proactively identify risks, issues and dependencies that may impact programme delivery.


**Cross\-Workstream Integration**

* Collaborate closely with Application, ERP, Security, Identity, Data, Procurement and Business Readiness leads to ensure all technical dependencies are understood, managed and delivered.
* Ensure infrastructure services are provisioned in line with application migration schedules and business cutover plans.

**Experience \& Qualifications**

title: Data Architect, Common Data Products
description:
*Founded in 1910, KONE* 
*is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an* 
*innovation and sustainability* 
*leader with repeated* 
*recognitions by* 
*Forbes, Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others.*
*KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market.*
**KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI)** 
 is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.
   

  

**KONE IT** 
 is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud\-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.  Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation are at the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part of KONE’s success.
   

  

 IT professionals \- KONE Corporation
   

  

 We are looking for a
   

  

**Data Architect, Common Data Products**
 to join KONE IT Enterprise Data \& Analytics team in Pune, India. The team is driving forward Data Foundation, a new way of working with data using the latest cloud technology Databricks on AWS leveraging modern multi\-hop medallion data architecture. Data Foundation is a key enabler in KONE digital transformation creating ability to develop new scalable AI/ML and digital use cases by leveraging data across the whole organization. In our approach, data products play a vital role in business value generation. Driving optimized data architecture practices is crucial to ensure reusability and maintainability of data products.
   

  

 Finance Data Architect is responsible for ensuring an effective data supply chain within Finance Data Domain on our Databricks platform. This includes designing and optimizing the data architecture from the data ingestion layer (bronze) to the business\-optimized data consumption layers (gold), enhancing the value of available data products, and documenting the physical data architecture of the data products. Finance data domain encompasses data integrations from various application systems, and the finance data products are utilized by multiple consumers across the company for different use cases, functions, and teams.
   

  

 The responsibilities of a Data Architect on Databricks platform include designing, developing, and creating data products to meet business data needs. This role also involves providing data architecture support to all stakeholders and offering guidance on technical issues arising from data\-related problems and incidents, as well as recommending actions to mitigate these issues. Data Architect works closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Global Data Owners, Enterprise Architects, Data Scientists, and development teams across the organization.
   

  

**As Data Architect your main responsibilities will be:**
* Analyzing data requirements and forming information requirements specifications for data products. Translating business requirements into clear data requirements for end\-to\-end data pipeline creation and business optimized data consumption.
* Designing data architecture and data products: Data architecture design, data modelling and data quality assurance activities.
* Driving data related innovation creation, such as developing new data products, and providing guidance to data consumers about existing data products and data consumption capabilities.
* Translating KONE's strategic objectives into data requirements on the Databricks platform, while incorporating a data architecture perspective into decision\-making and planning activities to effectively manage complex implementations.
* Identifying data architecture improvement needs and opportunities and ensure that the improvements are incorporated into roadmaps, and to source systems or data consuming systems roadmaps, when required.
* Supporting in incident handling process when the incident is related to data. Helping in identifying data flow and data quality flaws causing these incidents and preparing change proposals to permanently fix them.
* Data product cataloguing to data catalog to improve availability of data documentation, and usability of data by the data consumers.


**To succeed in Data Architect role, following professional experience will play a key role:**
* Master’s degree in engineering, computer science, management information systems, or a related field
* 12\-15\+ years of professional hands\-on experience in data architecture, data modeling, data engineering, analytical data processing, software engineering in enterprise working environment.
* Subject matter experience in finance processes and genuine passion understand the data produced in the finance business processes. Previous working experience in enterprise systems, such as SAP ERP FI/CO, FSCM.
* Experience in working with complex data enterprise landscapes (raw, semi structured, and unstructured data with different patterns batch, real\-time, streaming) from multiple business processes and applications.
* Ability to write clear documentation and visualize data architecture design as data pipelines and data models (3NF, dimensional modeling) with clear information requirements. Ability to provide data architecture support on hands\-on level to data engineering teams.
* Proven coding skills with multiple languages (SQL, Python) with hands\-on experience in industry standard software development life cycle methods, DevSecOps/DataOps practices spanning the full data product/data pipeline lifecycle.
* Technical expertise in following tech stack: Databricks data engineering, multi\-hop medallion architecture, Unity Catalog, Airflow, DBT, AWS Glue, AWS EMR, AWS Athena, Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Terraform, Gitlab/Github. (Databricks and AWS certifications is an advantage).
* Expertise in cybersecurity guidelines, data privacy, compliancy regulations and quality assurance practices, and cloud FinOps.
* Experience in coaching and/or mentoring, proactive knowledge sharing and maturing DataOps practices.
* Passion to utilize agile development methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence, draw.io).
* Ability to work collaborate and deliver in agile sprints. Ability to work in a global multi\-cultural team across different countries and effectively collaborate within the teams. Ability to self\-organize and be proactive, seek feedback, be courageous and resilient, and have excellent problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English language, and strong facilitation and communication skills.


*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*
 Read more on
 *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:

 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. * Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Manager\- Disaster Recovery (DB)**
**The opportunity**
 At EY, our Consulting practice brings together strategy, technology, and operations to deliver real\-world, value\-driven outcomes for our clients. As part of our database and data platform team, you will work with global clients to design, modernize, and optimize mission\-critical database environments. Leveraging EY’s integrated service offerings and innovative technology ecosystems, you will help organizations accelerate their cloud transformation and build resilient, future\-ready data platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Engage with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable database infrastructure solutions
* Provide advisory on database strategy, modernization, and cloud adoption
* Design, implement, and manage enterprise database platforms across Oracle, SQL Server, and other database technologies like NoSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, etc.
* Perform installation, upgrades, patching, migration, and performance tuning
* Ensure high availability, backup/recovery, disaster recovery (DR), and security of database environments
* Configure and manage database\-level DR solutions such as replication, log shipping, clustering, Always\-On, Data Guard, etc.
* Participating in DR planning, readiness validation, and periodic DR drills in collaboration with infra teams
* Develop and maintain DR plans, recovery runbooks, recovery procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Support cloud migration and transformation initiatives (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS) including DR design considerations
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Troubleshot complex database and infrastructure issues including failover and recovery scenarios
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and best practices including HA/DR frameworks for consulting engagements
* Support proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations


**Requirements**
* We’re looking for people with functional knowledge and diversified background in the following areas:
* 8–11 years of experience in database administration and engineering roles
* Strong hands\-on expertise in at least two database platforms such as Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server
* Strong understanding of database high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) concepts and implementations
* Practical experience in database failover, backup/recovery, and DR technologies (e.g., Data Guard, Always\-On, replication)
* Exposure to enterprise DR/BCP concepts, with participation in DR drills or failover testing preferred
* Experience with additional databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or cloud\-native databases
* Exposure to infrastructure components including OS (Linux/Windows), virtualization, storage, and compute
* Hands\-on experience in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including DR\-aware architectures
* Knowledge of automation/scripting (Shell, PowerShell, Python)
* Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines is preferred
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to clients
* Experience working in consulting or client\-facing environments is preferred


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. You will gain exposure to large\-scale transformation programs, cutting\-edge database and cloud technologies, and global clients. We offer a collaborative and inclusive culture, continuous learning opportunities, and a platform to build a strong consulting career while deepening your technical expertise.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes \& Terraform**
**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.

* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.

* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.

* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.

title: Oracle OCI Exadata Architect – 12+ Years
description:
**Job Description – Oracle OCI Exadata Architect**
**Position** 
 : Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 12\+ Years
   

  

**Role Level:** 
 Architect / Lead SME
   

  

**Location** 
 : Chennai
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
   

  

 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on Architect/Lead SME role requiring strong technical leadership and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D).
* Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
* Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
* Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching, including pre\-checks, validation and rollback planning.
* Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
* Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
* Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
* Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
* Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
* Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
* Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
* Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.


**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking**
 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
   

  

 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
   

  

 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
   

  

**Experience Supporting Large Enterprise Oracle Database Environments Is Required.**
 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Certifications**
 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
   

  

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
* Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
* Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
* Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
* Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications


**Candidate Profile**
 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
   

  

 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.
   

  

 The role requires strong communication, customer\-facing, troubleshooting and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, production incidents, architecture reviews, migrations, patching and performance optimization in an enterprise managed\-services environment.

**Ciklum**

 **Gen AI Principal Lead**

With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a POSITION\_NAME, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Lead the transformation of software development lifecycle into an AI\-agentic model — where autonomous and semi\-autonomous AI agents handle defined portions of requirements analysis, coding, testing, code review, and deployment, under a governed human\-oversight framework. Own both the technical architecture and the organizational rollout.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assess the current SDLC end\-to\-end and identify which stages are suitable for agent autonomy, agent\-assist, or remain human\-owned (a maturity/readiness map, not a blanket "automate everything")
* Design and stand up the agentic architecture: agent orchestration layer, tool/permission scoping, approval and escalation gates, integration with existing CI/CD and code review systems
* Define and implement guardrails: security review for agent\-generated code, cost/usage controls, rollback and audit mechanisms, human sign\-off checkpoints for high\-risk changes
* Select and integrate the agent tooling stack (build vs. buy decisions across orchestration frameworks, coding agents, testing agents, deployment agents)
* Run a phased rollout (pilot team → expanded pilot → org\-wide) with clear success metrics at each stage — cycle time, defect rate, agent\-error rate, developer trust/adoption
* Own change management: training engineering teams on new workflows, redefining code\-review and QA roles, working with security/compliance on new risk surfaces
* Report to engineering leadership on ROI, risk, and adoption — with honest calibration of what's actually autonomous vs. assisted


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years software engineering experience, including senior/staff\-level architecture ownership
* Demonstrated production experience with AI agent frameworks and LLM tool\-use patterns
* Deep knowledge of modern SDLC/DevOps tooling and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience leading a cross\-functional technology change initiative (not just a technical build)


**Desirable**
* Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive environment (agent guardrails matter more there)
* Prior consulting/transformation\-program background
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent\-tool integration standards

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment

* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

title: Ingénieur Sécurité Cloud
description:
Le portfolio de Siemens Digital Industries Software accompagne tous les secteurs industriels (Automobile, Aéronautique, Electronique, Energie, Pharma, Cosmétique, Agroalimentaire, ...) dans leur transformation numérique.
   

  

 Venez faire preuve d’ingéniosité à nos côtés et donner un nouveau sens à votre carrière dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et humain !
   

  

**Votre terrain de jeu:**
 Vous rêvez de concevoir et défendre des architectures cloud robustes ? De travailler sur des applications SaaS protégeant des milliers d’utilisateurs ?
   

  

 Notre portefeuille cloud s'étend rapidement et nous avons besoin d'un expert cloud passionné pour consolider notre posture SaaS, automatiser nos contrôles de sécurité, et devenir le "gardien" de notre infrastructure cloud.
   

  

 Audit et hardening de nos configurations AWS (IAM, networking, storage)
   

  

* Implémenter la gestion des vulnérabilités des containers de bout en bout
* Automatiser la détection des mauvaises configurations cloud (shift\-left)
* Implémenter les bonnes pratiques de sécurité cloud (CIS Benchmarks, AWS Well\-Architected)
* Réduire notre "blast radius" en cas d'incident (data exposure, compromise)
* Mentorer les équipes DevOps/Dev sur les principes du "secure by design \& by default"


 Vos responsabilités :
   

  

* Architecture \& Sécurité AWS (35%)


 Vous concevrez et maintiendrez des architectures cloud sécurisées :
   

  

* Design de VPC \& Networking : VPC architecture, subnets, Security Groups, NACLs, VPC Flow Logs
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM) : Policies granulaires, role\-based access, least privilege, service accounts
* Data Protection : Encryption at rest (KMS, S3 encryption), encryption in transit (TLS), secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault)
* Container Security : ECR scanning, image hardening, runtime security
* S3 Security : Bucket policies, ACLs, public access block, versioning, MFA delete
* Container Vulnerability Management \& ECR Security (30%)


 Vous gérerez les vulnérabilités de bout en bout :
   

  

* Déployer \& maintenir des outils de scan de containers
* Contrôle d’intégrité des images docker
* Maintenir les images à jour
* Trier les vulnérabilités et établir les SLAs de remédiation
* Collaborer avec les équipes pour corriger les vulnérabilités
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) Security (10%)


 Vous sécuriserez nos CloudFormation :
   

  

* Revue de code des changements infrastructure
* Scanner IaC pour détecter les vulnérabilités avant déploiement (Checkov)
* Créer des templates "secure by default"
* Établir les standards de sécurité pour IaC dans toute l'organisation
* Collaboration \& Mentoring (5%)


 Vous guiderez les équipes DevOps/Dev vers "secure by design \& by default" :
   

  

* Revue de code des configurations cloud des équipes
* Sessions de sensibilisation sur les bonnes pratiques de sécurité dans le cloud
* Mentorer les ingénieurs juniors sur la sécurité dans cloud
* Participer à la gestion d’incident de sécurité


**Ce CDI est rattaché à notre site Lyon (69\) est à pouvoir dès que possible**
**Statut : Cadre**
**Les atouts pour réussir :**
* Bonne expérience en sécurité cloud ou infrastructure AWS
* 2\+ ans d'expérience pratique avec AWS (produits core : IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, KMS)
* Historique de 5\+ architectures Cloud sécurisées conçues/auditées en production
* Expérience avec containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) et sécurité des containers
* Anglais courant (communication dans un contexte international)


 Vous hésitez encore à postuler? Sachez qu’une équipe expérimentée sera là pour vous accompagner et partager avec vous tout son savoir, vous donnant ainsi toutes les clés nécessaires à l’atteinte de votre succès. Nous recherchons avant tout un savoir\-être et une personne qui saura s’intégrer dans nos équipes, avec motivation, engouement et envie d'apprendre.
   

  

**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**
 Intégrer Siemens Digital Industries Software vous permet d'évoluer dans un contexte international et dans un environnement de haute technologie. Vous bénéficiez d’un cadre favorable à votre développement et à votre succès.
   

  

 Chez Siemens, nous nous dépassons constamment pour construire un avenir meilleur. Pour cela, nous avons besoin des esprits les plus innovants et diversifiés en matière de digital pour concevoir la réalité de demain.
   

  

 Nous valorisons la diversité en tant qu’inclusion et collaboration de différentes pensées, origines, expériences et expertises, à tous les niveaux et dimensions de l’organisation. C’est pour cela que Siemens Digital Industries Software recrute et reconnait tous les talents.
   

  

**Rémunération et Avantages**
 La fourchette salariale pour ce poste est de €52\.800 à €89\.700 et ce rôle est éligible pour une compensation incitative. La rémunération réelle offerte est basée sur les compétences professionnelles, l'expérience et la formation/éducation pertinentes du candidat retenu. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

Job Title: OCI Cloud Architect
 



 Location: Chennai /Hybrid
 



 Experience: 15 \+ Years
 



 Support time: UK Time Zone
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 Job Summary We are seeking an experienced OCI Cloud Architect to manage and support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments across Development, UAT, and Production, including Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments. The role requires strong expertise in cloud security, application hosting, patching, upgrades, CI/CD pipelines, and the design of highly available and disaster\-resilient architectures.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Own the architecture and day\-to\-day operation of the OCI compartments across production, DR and non\-production tiers (DEV, TST, UAT, QA, SIT).
* Maintain secure, scalable, highly available designs across regions, including VCN design, DRG/FastConnect connectivity, load balancing and public/private access separation.
* Manage Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments on OCI.
* Implement and manage OCI security including IAM, policies, compartments, and access controls.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.
* Host, Migration, operate, and support enterprise applications on OCI, including Oracle EBS.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and automation for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for OCI provisioning and configuration.
* Design and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for OCI and EBS.
* Run vulnerability management and enforce security and governance standards — IAM policies, compartments, identity services, auditing and logging — within the customer's retained identity and security governance model.
* Design and maintain HA and DR, including Data Guard, remote peering and application failover; run DR tests and evidence RTO/RPO attainment.
* Perform DR testing, failover exercises, and ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.
* Apply shift\-left automation to reduce repeat incidents, and support FinOps review of compute, load balancer and storage consumption.
* Operate within the customer's change management (CAB), incident and problem management processes, respecting tenant ownership and break\-glass controls retained by the customer.
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.
* Excellent troubleshooting and stakeholder communication; comfortable working within a shift roster.
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity, and cost across OCI and EBS environments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, database, and application issues across all environments.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity and cost; troubleshoot across infrastructure, database and platform layers.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, SOPs and runbooks; participate in service governance and reporting against SLA/XLA measures.
* Collaborate with application, database, DevOps, and security teams.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Experience: 15 \+ Years
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Deep hands\-on OCI experience — networking, security, governance, compartment and tenancy design, multi\-region architecture.
* Proven experience running Oracle EBS environments at the infrastructure, OS and database layers, in a shared\-responsibility model alongside an application partner.
* Oracle Database 19c on Exadata (Exadata VM clusters / DB Systems), Data Guard, backup and recovery.
* Terraform and CI/CD pipeline delivery; automation\-first operating mindset.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Proven experience managing Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) hosted environments.
* Experience supporting Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
* Strong understanding of OCI networking, Security, and governance.
* Expertise in Oracle EBS administration, patching, cloning, Migration and upgrades.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong knowledge of High Availability and Disaster Recovery architectures.
* Experience with Oracle Databases (Autonomous, DB Systems, Exadata preferred).
* Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Modern Workplace Engineer / Architect to lead the administration, support, design, and architecture of Microsoft's modern workplace technologies.
 



 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure, Microsoft 365, Intune, and endpoint management, while also providing Level 2 and Level 3 support for critical enterprise environments.
 



  





 The role requires strong troubleshooting, automation, and solution design capabilities, with the ability to architect scalable and secure solutions that enhance operational efficiency and user experience.
 



  





**Experience:** 
 8\-12 Years
 



**Shift:** 
 US Shift Timings
 



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




**Mandatory** 




 • Active Directory (AD)
 



 • Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
 



 • Microsoft Azure
 



 • Microsoft 365 Administration
 



 • Microsoft Intune
 



 • Endpoint Management
 



 • Windows 10/11 Administration
 



 • PowerShell Scripting
 



 • Identity \& Access Management
 



 • Conditional Access and MFA
 



 • L2/L3 Troubleshooting \& Operational Support
 



 • Solution Design and Architecture
 



  





**Preferred / Nice to Have** 




 • Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)
 



 • Qualys Patch and Vulnerability Management
 



 • Azure Automation and Microsoft Graph API
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L2/L3 support and technical leadership for enterprise workplace technologies.
* Design, implement, and maintain solutions across Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, Microsoft 365, and Intune.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex production incidents.
* Architect secure identity, endpoint management, and cloud solutions aligned with business and security requirements.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation to improve operational efficiency.
* Support Microsoft Intune device lifecycle management, application deployment, compliance policies, and security controls.
* Manage Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and related administrative functions.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver technology initiatives and operational improvements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
* Participate in on\-call support and major incident response activities.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




 • 8\-12 years of experience in Microsoft Infrastructure and Modern Workplace technologies.
 



 • Proven experience handling enterprise\-scale environments.
 



 • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to independently lead technical discussions, design reviews, and architecture decisions.
 



 • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Willingness to work in US shift timings and participate in on\-call support rotations.
 



  





**Preferred Certifications** 




 • AZ\-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator
 



 • AZ\-305: Azure Solutions Architect
 



 • MS\-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator
 



 • MD\-102: Endpoint Administrator
 



 • SC\-300: Identity and Access Administrator

title: AWS RDS, PostgreSQL
description:
**Job Summary**
 Infra Architect position for a hybrid work model requiring twelve to fifteen years of experience in designing and optimizing resilient cloud native platforms. Role focuses on AWS environments using services such as compute and distributed data stores to support high volume Medicare and Medicaid claims processing for payer systems. The architect will ensure scalability compliance and performance for critical claims workloads.
   

  

**R** 
 AWS DBA ( should have strong in DB technologies and migration experience , willing to learn terraform )
   

  

 PostgreSQL, NoSQL Aurora variants included and DynamoDB
   

  

* Expertise in Amazon RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, and Redshift administration.
* Strong skills in backup/restore, high availability, Multi‑AZ, and cross‑Region replication.
* Proficiency with performance tuning—query optimization, indexing, and monitoring using CloudWatch \& Performance Insights.

title: Oracle Cloud Infra Admin_APIGEE Platform Infra Architect_Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – APIGEE Platform Architect Position**
 Over the last decade, API\-led connectivity, cloud\-native modernization and digital transformation have become critical for ensuring scalability, security and resilience across enterprise ecosystems. To support this evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Google Apigee, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation to deliver secure, high\-performance and highly available API management platforms for mission\-critical business applications.
   

  

 As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Manager APIGEE Platform Architect supporting large\-scale API management environments across hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Google Apigee, Kubernetes, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Automation, API Security and Enterprise Architecture to deliver secure, scalable and highly available solutions for mission\-critical enterprise integrations and API ecosystems. This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee Apigee platform architecture and implementation.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Apigee and platform issues.
* Design and support end\-to\-end platform migrations and modernization programs.
* Drive infrastructure automation, governance and security standards.
* Collaborate with networking, cloud, security and DevOps teams.
* Define HA, DR, scalability and resiliency requirements.
* Establish observability, monitoring and operational readiness standards.


**Strong Understanding Of:**
* Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid architecture
* Kubernetes platforms (GKE, EKS, AKS, and On\-Prem Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms including GCP, AWS, and Azure
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
* API Security concepts including OAuth2, JWT, TLS, and mTLS
* CI/CD pipelines and APIOps implementation
* Monitoring and Observability using Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, and Splunk
* Disaster Recovery (DR), High Availability (HA), and Resiliency design
* Networking, Load Balancing, DNS, and Traffic Management
* Platform Governance, Security Controls, and Compliance Frameworks


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills
* Team\-player mindset with collaborative working style
* Self\-motivated and proactive attitude
* Ability to lead architecture reviews and design workshops
* Experience driving Proof of Concepts (POCs) and innovation initiatives
* Strong decision\-making and technical leadership capabilities
* Ability to work across global and cross\-functional teams


**To Qualify for the Role, you must have**
* 8 to 14 years of relevant experience in API Management, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or Enterprise Architecture
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Google Apigee (Apigee X and/or Apigee Hybrid)
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes operations and platform architecture
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, IAM, and infrastructure services
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or equivalent tools
* Hands\-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and APIOps practices
* Expertise in enterprise security controls, API security, and compliance requirements
* Experience leading architecture design sessions, workshops, and technical governance reviews
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-scale API platform implementations
* Ability to drive platform modernization, migration, and transformation initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-team collaboration experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, or Apigee certifications are preferred


**Additionally, Good To Have**
* IBM API Connect (APIC) and DataPower migration experience.
* Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD, Flux CD, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Experience with security scanning and vulnerability management tools.
* API Developer Portal, API Monetization, and API Analytics expertise.
* Experience defining SLA/SLO, KPI dashboards, and operating models.
* Relevant certifications such as:
+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
+ Google Apigee API Engineer Certification
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self\-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud\-based solutions for the company.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
